hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line1: Clarity comes after purity, not before it. First the infection is quieted; then the self learns to see without fever.
hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line2: Consecrated copper holds the lesson of endurance: it changed, oxidized, and became stable.
hemomancy.acolyte.about_clarity.line3: When your blood is fully pale, that lesson can become a halo rather than a wound.
hemomancy.acolyte.absolved.line1: Most of the old red has gone pale. You may mourn it. Many do.
hemomancy.acolyte.absolved.line2: Let the grief pass through clean water. What remains will be yours in a way the blood never was.
hemomancy.acolyte.clarity.line1: You have entered the second water. The blood is quiet; now the world is loud.
hemomancy.acolyte.clarity.line2: Do not confuse sharp sight for certainty. The clearest eye can still become merciless.
hemomancy.acolyte.cleansing.line1: You stand in the long middle now. The blood has learned fear, and frightened things cling.
hemomancy.acolyte.cleansing.line2: The Silver Veil may settle over you in moments of danger. Treat it as a quiet instruction: do not reopen what is closing.
hemomancy.acolyte.corrupted.line1: The first dose has opened the wound. That pain means the blood-memory is losing certainty.
hemomancy.acolyte.corrupted.line2: Move carefully. The old current will still answer if you call it, and every call teaches it your name again.
hemomancy.acolyte.enlightened.line1: §7[The Acolyte bows until their forehead nearly touches their clasped hands]
hemomancy.acolyte.enlightened.line2: The Lady weeps for joy, or for warning. With the Unstained, those tears are often the same water.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_clarity.line1: Clarity is awakened through consecrated copper, then deepened by offerings that teach perception instead of hunger.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_clarity.line2: Silver chalices, hemolytic plating, and verdigris rites strengthen the halo that purity made possible.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line1: Purity grows through restraint, mercy, and offerings that ask nothing of blood.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line2: Hemolytic solution begins the work. Lethean flowers, pale dew, sleep, clean labor, and spared life continue it.
hemomancy.acolyte.how_purify.line3: Do not rush. A wound closed too quickly keeps rot beneath the skin.
hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line1: Our Lady of Still Waters is not a crown in the sky. She is the cold place where fever breaks.
hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line2: When the crimson fungus spread through blood and memory, the world answered as bodies answer infection.
hemomancy.acolyte.lady_lore.line3: She is that answer given face and patience. Defensive, not cruel. Still, not empty.
hemomancy.acolyte.not_on_path.line1: §7[The Acolyte lowers their voice as the church air cools around you]
hemomancy.acolyte.not_on_path.line2: You have not begun the washing. If the blood troubles you, speak with a Zealot and approach the podium with hemolytic solution.
hemomancy.acolyte.purified.line1: Your blood is white in the way winter bone is white. The first transformation has fixed itself.
hemomancy.acolyte.purified.line2: If you choose clarity, bring consecrated copper to the podium and let the last crimson habit fall silent.
hemomancy.acolyte.silver_veil.line1: The Silver Veil is the inner skin of purification. It shields by refusing intimacy with the crimson current.
hemomancy.acolyte.silver_veil.line2: It does not make you innocent. It makes distance possible, and distance is where choice begins.
hemomancy.acolyte.tainted.line1: The stain is thinning. You may feel hollow where power used to answer.
hemomancy.acolyte.tainted.line2: That hollow place is not failure. It is room returning to you.
hemomancy.acolyte.verdigris.line1: Verdigris is copper after long exposure, changed without surrendering its work.
hemomancy.acolyte.verdigris.line2: We use it because purity is not untouchedness. It is survival made honest.
hemomancy.acolyte.who_are_you.line1: We are keepers of still water: not judges first, not executioners first, but witnesses to what infection does to the self.
hemomancy.acolyte.who_are_you.line2: Some of us were Harbingers. Some were family to Harbingers. All of us know the crimson is easier to inherit than to shed.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.chisel_lore: The Chisel Station lets you inscribe rune patterns into prepared materials, encoding specific arcane functions. Rune crafting requires mastery of Degree Four — what you have just achieved. Study the rune patterns carefully; each combination produces a different functional result.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.line1: §7[The Alchemist sets down a precision tool and turns to you with a look of genuine respect]
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.line2: Adept of the Brotherhood. You have proven you can work with the machines. Now I can show you the stations that work on you.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.scar_station_l: The Cerebral Scarring Station is not merely a crafting bench — it is a surgical instrument. Using a knapper, you carve sacred patterns onto blank scar plates. These patterns, once worn, open new neural and venous pathways within the mind. Each scar changes what manipulations you can sustain and how strongly your tendencies express themselves.
hemomancy.alchemist.apotheos.line1: §4[The Alchemist stops entirely and looks at you for a long moment with an expression that is equal parts awe and something almost like vertigo.]
hemomancy.alchemist.apotheos.line2: Apotheos. §oI built machines to process blood. I never — I did not understand that the machines were always pointing at §4§osomething§r. I understand now. There is nothing left for me to teach you. There never was anything I could teach you that your blood did not already know.
hemomancy.alchemist.apotheos.reflection: §oThe Alembic distils. The Centrifuge separates. The Loom weaves. The Incubator grows. I spent my life in the belief that these were the end of it — the summit of hemomantic engineering. But they are not the summit. §4§oYou§r are the summit. The machines were never the product. You were. I was building toward you.
hemomancy.alchemist.archon.line1: §4[The Alchemist straightens instinctively and bows their head]
hemomancy.alchemist.archon.line2: Archon. Every machine in this Outpost is yours to command. I have nothing left to teach — only to maintain what serves you.
hemomancy.alchemist.clarity.line1: §7[The Alchemist looks straight through you as though you are not there, then returns their attention to their work without a word]
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.blood_cr: At this stage, blood crafting graduates to what the Lodge calls Grand-tier work. The patterns grow three-dimensional and demanding — and more importantly, the most complex structures can no longer be powered by a single strike of a key. They require a sustained blood supply: a Blood Conduit pipe carrying a continuous flow within range of the pattern. The pipeline network you have been building is no longer optional infrastructure. It is the difference between what you can assemble and what remains beyond your reach.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.incubato: The Morphling Incubator sustains and develops morphling organisms — living constructs grown from blood and organic matter. The incubator provides the stable environment they need to mature. Morphlings are not simple creatures; they are extensions of your hemomantic will, shaped by the tendencies you have cultivated.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. Few ever reach this stage of understanding. The machines at this level operate on principles the uninitiated would call impossible.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Scarlet Sanctum. You are ready to understand the Somatic Loom — the heart of this Outpost's more advanced processes.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.loom_lore: The Somatic Loom is a memory-weaving device. It takes tendency-saturated materials and your own focused intent and binds them into crystallized blood memories — new manipulations. The Loom requires the right combination of tendency inputs; get the balance wrong and the weave collapses.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.memory_weav: Memory weaving is the process of encoding a blood manipulation into a permanent crystalline form. Think of it as teaching your blood a new word. The Loom reads the tendencies you provide, finds a pattern it recognizes, and sets that pattern into the crystal. Equip the result at a Mnemonic Reliquary to make it your own.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_hint: Hold it in your hand and speak to me again.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.barbed_: The Barbed Blade. A hemomantic weapon — the barbs are living extensions designed to draw blood on contact. Each hit feeds a small return into the wielder's blood reserve. Low return per hit; reliable accumulation over a sustained engagement.

The blade is not optimised for damage. It is optimised for collection. If you need to fight and refuel simultaneously it is the right choice. If you need to end something quickly, choose a different tool.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blaze_p: Blaze powder. Highly volatile combustion compound — concentrated ignition chemistry from the Nether. In the Alembic, it processes as a quality Flammeus tendency input: the volatile compounds strip cleanly into Fervent Enzyme concentrate.
Handle with care during transport. Blaze powder ignites from friction. Keep it dry, away from blood vials, and well away from open flame until you intend to use it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_c: Blood crystal shard. Fragments of crystallised sanguine energy — lower purity than a full formation, but still workable. Useful as lower-tier Alembic inputs or supplementary ingredients.
Do not discard them. The Alembic accepts them at reduced yield. Accumulate shards until you have enough to process a meaningful batch.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_g: The blood gourd. Your primary blood storage vessel. Every practitioner should upgrade their gourd as their initiation deepens — a larger gourd means a deeper reserve, which means more sustained casting.
Upgrade tiers are White, Red, and Black — capacity increases with each. Do not treat the White tier as permanent equipment.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_v: The blood vial. The standard vessel for collected blood. Fill it at the Ghastly Alembic — the Alembic draws a precise measured volume and seals it for processing.
Filled vials are input for the Vial Centrifuge. The centrifuge reads the tendency distribution in the blood and separates it into concentrated enzyme outputs.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.bloody_: The Bloody Flask. Larger capacity than the vial — holds a meaningful volume of blood without requiring the full processing chain. Useful for transport between a collection point and the Alembic.

The Flask is not a processing input in itself. Fill it, carry it, decant into the Alembic when you are ready. Do not confuse it with the gourd — the gourd is for active casting reserves; the Flask is for storage and transport.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.brewing: A brewing stand. The common practitioner's distillation device. Water-and-base model — produces blunt biological responses. It is a reasonable predecessor to what the Alembic does, in the same way that boiling meat over a fire is a predecessor to cooking.

The Alembic produces precise tendency concentrates. The stand produces threshold effects. Both are distillation. The difference is in resolution. Do not mistake familiarity with the stand for understanding of what the Alembic is doing.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.chalybe: Iron sulfide in a living skirt. A ridiculous phrase, and yet the snail makes it work.
Knap it while the creature is withdrawn. If you must kill for scraps, you have already failed the material.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.cleansi: Cleansing hemolymph. A blue-tinted lytic fluid derived from a Hemolymphopoda — a creature whose circulatory chemistry is naturally opposed to standard blood-matrix compounds.
From a purely technical standpoint it is an efficient lytic agent with notable stability properties. What it is used for by others is not my concern.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.dendrit: The Dendritic Distributor. Interface for the Skill Tree — your personal record of blood-craft competencies. The Distributor reads your vascular state and presents the options available at your current degree.
You can only open as many branches as your initiation permits. The skills available at Disciple are not the skills available at Adept. Keep returning as you advance.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.dicentr: Dicentra sap — harvested from the Bleeding Heart plant. One of the cleanest Animus-tendency organic inputs available. The sap's chemistry is naturally rich in the volatile compounds the Alembic strips for life-force concentration.
Renders especially good yield on Vivacious Enzyme processing. If you are focusing Animus tendency, Bleeding Heart cultivation is worth the investment.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.enzyme_: Ferric Enzyme — Ferric tendency. Ferric is the iron tendency: blood that conducts, reinforces, and binds structure. Ferric manipulations harden the body and channel energy with precision.
Ferric concentrates from metallic or mineral-dense organic compounds. Ferric practitioners make better use of blood-structure crafting than most.
Fervent Enzyme — Flammeus tendency. Flammeus is the combustion tendency: heat, ignition, volatile pressure. Fervent manipulations channel blood-heat outward.
Distil combustible compounds in the Alembic, then centrifuge the enriched output.
Frigid Enzyme — Congeatio tendency. Congeatio is the stasis tendency: blood made cold, slow, crystalline. Frigid manipulations immobilise, preserve, and impose stillness.
Congeatio concentrates from materials exhibiting natural preservation or cold-resistance run through the Alembic.
Incandescent Enzyme — Lux tendency. Lux is the radiance tendency: blood as light-bearer, illusory force, perceptual distortion. Incandescent manipulations bend what can be seen.
Lux concentrates from luminescent organic materials run through the Alembic.

Neurotic Enzyme — Ductilis tendency. Ductilis is the shaping tendency: blood made pliable, controllable, architecturally functional. Allows precise physical shaping — redirecting blood flow, forming barriers.
Centrifuge output from flexible or adhesive organic materials processed through the Alembic.
Ruinous Enzyme — Mortem tendency. Mortem is the entropy tendency: breakdown, dissolution, the blood as agent of ending. Ruinous manipulations accelerate decay and sap vitality.
Mortem concentrates from decomposing organic materials in the Alembic. The Covenant treats it with appropriate wariness.
Umbral Enzyme — Tenebris tendency. Tenebris is the shadow tendency: blood drawn away from light, into concealment. Umbral manipulations suppress visibility and dampen perception.
Tenebris concentrates from materials with natural darkness affinity run through the Alembic.

Vivacious Enzyme — Animus tendency. Animus is the life-force tendency: movement, vitality, the body's will to continue. Manipulations unlocked by this enzyme accelerate healing, enhance physical speed, and sustain the body under strain.
Obtain it by running enriched blood samples through the Vial Centrifuge after distilling organic life-force materials in the Alembic.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.erythro: Cut cleanly and it remains useful. Tear it apart and you mostly get wet pulp with ambitions.
The reef is not ore. Harvest like a gardener, not a miner.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.foul_pa: Foul Paste. A dense organically derived compound used as the binding substrate in blood-structure crafting. The structure pattern requires both the physical blocks and the paste as the active bonding agent.
The Alembic produces it from specific organic inputs. Keep a steady supply — running out mid-pattern means starting over.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.ghastly: The Ghastly Alembic is the first and most essential machine in the Harbinger's toolkit. It receives raw organic inputs and distils them into concentrated alchemical compounds.
Blood vials, enriched extracts, foul paste — all of it comes from the Alembic. Master its input recipes first. Every downstream process runs on Alembic output.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.glass_b: A glass bottle. Standard alchemical vessel in common use. It holds liquid, it seals adequately, and it will shatter under pressure. We use the vial system for a reason — the precise calibrated volume of a blood vial cannot be replicated with common glassware.

If you need to store something unstabilised that cannot go in a blood vial, the glass bottle is functional. For anything involving blood distillation, processing, or tendency work, use the correct vessel.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.glowsto: Glowstone dust. Luminescent mineral compound from the Nether. In the Alembic, the light-chemistry processes as a quality Lux tendency input — the radiance compounds strip cleanly into Incandescent Enzyme concentrate.

Incandescent Enzyme yield from glowstone dust is good — clean extraction, minimal waste compounds. If you are investing in Lux tendency work, glowstone is among the most reliable raw inputs available through conventional means.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.hematic: Hematic iron scrap. A by-product of smelting iron near prolonged blood-saturation. The iron absorbs trace blood compounds and acquires useful properties — fire resistance, tensile strength, slight conductivity to blood energy.
Smelt the scrap into ingots before use. The scrap form is chemically unstable; the ingot is where the interesting properties stabilise.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.hemolyt: Hemolytic solution. Chemically it is a lytic compound — it breaks down blood matrices at the cellular level. Effective against blood-afflicted organisms because their structural integrity depends entirely on the blood matrix it disrupts.
The compound's production requires a different process from standard blood distillation. It works. That is all I have to say about it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.iron_in: Iron ingot. Ordinary smelted iron — no blood affinity whatsoever at this stage. Standard iron has no hematic properties. The blood-saturation that produces hematic iron scrap only occurs when the smelting environment itself is blood-charged.

If you need hematic iron, you cannot produce it from standard ingots. Source the scrap from areas of blood saturation, or smelt near concentrated sanguine formation. The blood does the work during smelting; ordinary iron just receives it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.living_: The Living Syringe. A precision extraction and injection tool — draws blood from the practitioner or a target and delivers it as a direct bolus injection. Useful for precise control of blood volume in field conditions.
In direct application it can disrupt a target's metabolic state. It is not a primary weapon. It is a tool that happens to have secondary applications when other options are unavailable.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.mnemoni: The Mnemonic Reliquary. This is where you load and manage your active blood manipulations. Place the memory crystals you have integrated — the Reliquary organises them into your active loadout.
Manipulations must be loaded before they can be cast. The Reliquary holds your selection; the vascular system holds the capacity. Do not confuse having a crystal with being able to use it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.morphli: The Morphling Incubator sustains living constructs grown from blood and organic base materials. Morphlings are hemomantic organisms — extensions of the practitioner's will given biological form.
The incubator provides the stable temperature and blood-saturated environment morphlings require to develop. Different morphling types emerge from different input combinations.
The Morphling Incubator operates at a level beyond your current initiation. Fifth degree is required.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.nether_: Nether Wart. The standard base catalyst in common brewing, but it has uses in the Alembic as well — the organic structure contains binding compounds that help stabilise volatile distillations that would otherwise produce waste compounds.
Do not treat it as a base ingredient the way the brewing stand does. In the Alembic it functions as a process stabiliser. Add it to runs where you are seeing erratic or unstable outputs.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.puppete: Puppeteering thread. The physical medium used in the Somatic Loom for memory weaving. The thread carries tendency-imprinted fibres — the Loom reads those fibres and uses them as a template during crystal formation.
The quality of your thread affects the precision of the weave. Damaged or low-quality thread increases the chance of a failed or misaligned memory crystal.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.recycle: Recycled Enzyme. When a memory crystal is no longer needed, the enzyme within can be partially recovered through the centrifuge.
The recovered enzyme is lower yield than a fresh distillation but still serves as input for further centrifuge processes or lower-tier memory weaving.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.redston: Redstone. The standard energy conductor of applied mechanics. The mineral chemistry has trace blood-mineral signatures that the Alembic identifies as Ferric tendency input — the conduction properties translate directly.

The Ferric tendency in blood is the conduction tendency: reinforcement, channelling, precision of energy transfer. Redstone occupies an analogous role in mechanical systems. That parallel is not coincidental. The Alembic processes it as such.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.salt_st: Field logs are full of errors. Valuable errors. Someone tested reef tissue, vent scale, and seawater in the same alembic and lived long enough to write annoyed corrections.
Treat any sample from that wreck as contaminated by both salt and devotion.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.sanguin: Sanguine formation — crystallised blood mineral. Forms naturally in places where blood power has pooled for a long time. It is the base input for almost everything processed in the Alembic.
Smash clusters to obtain shards. Shards refine into formation. Formation feeds the Alembic. The process is straightforward. The challenge is sourcing enough of it.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.scar_bl: Blank scar plate. This is what you bring to the Cerebral Scarring Station. The Station receives the blank and your knapper tool — you carve a pattern into the plate, and when worn, the scar opens specific venous and neural pathways.
The blank itself does nothing. It is potential. The pattern you carve into it — and whether you have the vascular prerequisites to sustain that pattern — is what determines the result.
Blank scar plates serve no purpose at your current degree. The Cerebral Scarring Station is not accessible until you have reached the fourth degree.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.scar_st: The Cerebral Scarring Station receives blank scar plates and a knapper tool — the practitioner carves a specific pattern into the plate. Worn scars open venous and neural pathways that standard practice cannot reach.
Each scar pattern produces a different effect. The station is only the carving surface; the real work is selecting the right pattern for your current needs.
The Cerebral Scarring Station is not accessible at your current degree. Reach the fourth degree first.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.slime_b: Slime ball. High-viscosity organic adhesive compound. In the Alembic, the chemistry reads as a strong Ductilis tendency input — the pliability and adhesive behaviour is chemically analogous to what makes blood malleable in shaping manipulations.
Useful input for Neurotic Enzyme production. The yield is reliable. Slimes are more available than you might expect once you know where to gather them.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.somatic: The Somatic Loom weaves memory crystals. Provide it with the correct tendency inputs and it encodes a specific manipulation into a crystalline form the practitioner can learn from.
The weave requires precise tendency ratios. A wrong ratio produces a failed crystal or no output at all. Study the pattern requirements before committing materials.
The Somatic Loom requires a deeper initiation than you currently hold. Return when you have reached the third degree.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.spore_s: Spore sac. Collected from Infected Fungus or from fungal creatures. The sac concentrates the spore mass used in several crafting processes — notably fungal implantation and certain Somatic Loom weave recipes.
Spores are biologically active even when dried. The Alembic neutralises the active compounds during processing; raw spore sacs in open storage are mildly hazardous.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.unknown: That is outside what I work with.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.vial_ce: The Vial Centrifuge separates blood compounds by tendency. Feed it filled blood vials and it spins them to concentration — sorting each tendency into discrete enzyme outputs.
The centrifuge's output depends on the tendency distribution in your blood, which is in turn influenced by your dominant tendency and what you have been doing.
hemomancy.alchemist.machines_overview: Every machine in this Outpost serves the same master: blood refinement. The Alembic distills, the Centrifuge separates, the Loom weaves. Each one builds upon the last. Learn them in sequence and the full system will reveal itself.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.alembic_lea: They are good tools. But they tend to leak, if only there was something to do with the waste... §7[The Alchemist trails off, glancing pointedly at a slab of venous stone on the workbench — and a shard of yellowed bone beside it — before returning to the vessels.]
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.alembic_lor: The Ghastly Alembic is your first and most important tool. Feed it raw materials — plants, fungi, creature parts — and it will distill them into usable alchemical extracts. These extracts power higher-level processes and fuel your manipulations. Master the Alembic before anything else.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.blood_gourd: Then hear this early: every good Harbinger carries a blood gourd of their own. Not borrowed. Not shared. Yours. Keep it on your person at all times — belt, satchel, wherever your hand finds it first in a crisis. A neglected gourd is a dead Harbinger's mistake.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.line1: §7[The Alchemist nods with approval as you approach]
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.line2: A Neophyte. Good — now the machinery has meaning. The Outpost runs on blood processing, and every station here serves a purpose in that chain.
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.explain: §7[The Alchemist does not look up]§r There is nothing to explain. Blood knowledge requires commitment. Every hour you spend on that path is an hour the machines go unlearned. I am busy. Good day.
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.line1: §7[The Alchemist glances up from their work, reads something in your bearing, and turns back to their instruments without expression]
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.line2: I have no time to teach someone who won't make use of my knowledge. The path you're walking leads away from everything these machines can offer you. Come back when you've decided where you actually stand.
hemomancy.alchemist.sanctified.final_mac: At the pinnacle, all the machines become one process. The Alembic feeds the Centrifuge, the Centrifuge calibrates the Loom, the Loom unlocks new rune patterns, and blood crafting pulls it all together into structures that reshape the world. Master every station, and you master the full language of hemomancy.
hemomancy.alchemist.sanctified.line1: Sanctified one. You stand at the threshold of the Hematic Order. The machines have given you everything they can at this stage — what remains is the final synthesis.
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.line1: §7[A figure in fitted work robes looks up from a complex arrangement of vessels and tubing, assessing you with a measured gaze]
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.line2: A newcomer. I am the Harbinger Alchemist — keeper of the Outpost's machines and processes. My craft is the art of blood made functional. But without initiation, these mechanisms would be wasted on you.
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.machines: The machines here respond to blood that has been refined through the rites of the Covenant. Earn your first degree, and I will teach you what each one does.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.blood_structu: Blood structure crafting is the most distinctive process you will learn as a Harbinger. You do not work at a bench — you build the pattern in the world itself, laying down blocks in a precise arrangement, then push your own blood through it with a blood key. If the pattern is correct and the blood cost is met, the structure assembles itself. The basic patterns are available to you now. They will teach you more than any explanation can.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.centrifuge_lo: The Vial Centrifuge separates blood compounds by tendency. Feed it an enriched vial and it will sort the tendencies within — Fungal, Umbral, Incandescent, Ferric, and the rest. Concentrated tendency vials can then be used in higher-tier crafting and to calibrate the Somatic Loom. Know your dominant tendency — it determines what the machines produce best.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.gourd_upgrade: Your gourd should grow as you do. Improve it whenever your rites permit, and do not stop at the first upgrade. A stronger vessel means deeper reserves, steadier casting, and fewer desperate choices when blood runs thin. Treat upgrading your gourd as ongoing discipline, not a one-time errand.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.line1: Votary. The blood tendency within you is beginning to take shape. The Vial Centrifuge will help you understand why that matters.
hemomancy.altar.already_blessed: The altar has already bestowed its blessing upon you. Our Lady's tears flow only once.
hemomancy.altar.blessed: §bThe Tears of Silthmere wash over the altar. A silver light floods your veins — Our Lady's blessing purifies you.
hemomancy.altar.brew_offered: §7The Lethean Brew is consumed by the altar's flame. Memories fade, and purity grows.
hemomancy.altar.chalice_offered: §bThe silver chalice rings with a pure tone. Clarity deepens.
hemomancy.altar.clarity_not_unlocked: The chalice resonates, but you have not yet unlocked clarity.
hemomancy.altar.icon_already_offered: The altar has already accepted a Pallid Icon from you. Its power flows only once.
hemomancy.altar.icon_offered: §bThe Pallid Icon blazes with silver fire upon the altar. A flood of clarity surges through you.
hemomancy.altar.lore: §7A cool mist rises from the stone... You sense the presence of Our Lady of Still Waters.
hemomancy.altar.not_on_path: The altar is silent. Only those who walk the Unstained path may hear its call.
hemomancy.altar.wreath_offered: §7The lethean poppies wilt upon the altar, their essence drawn into the stone. Purity rises.
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.harbinger_hin: Do not bring those things near me. I know what they do. I know what they smell.
[Her eyes fix on your hands, searching for glass, teeth, and movement.]
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.neutral.line1: [Annetta folds herself into the corner, fingers pressed white around the hilt of a small dagger. Her red hair hangs forward like a curtain.]
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.neutral.line2: No. No more tests. No questions. Please. Just leave me where the walls are still.
hemomancy.annetta.cowering.unstained_hin: If you are here from the still waters, then you know why I cannot pray cleanly anymore.
I will drink anything that makes the noise stop. I am tired of being proof.
hemomancy.annetta.cured_support.line1: [Her hair has gone white, but her hands no longer shake. She keeps herself between you and the thing she used to carry.]
hemomancy.annetta.cured_support.line2: Stay close. I can slow it. I can keep you breathing. Finish what mercy started.
hemomancy.annetta.event.bitten: The jar breaks open. Teeth find skin. Annetta's breath catches on the shape of the truth.
hemomancy.annetta.event.cured: The draught takes. Red drains from her hair as something older tears itself loose.
hemomancy.annetta.event.mutation: Annetta dies badly. The infection does not.
hemomancy.annetta.resolved.line1: [Annetta looks at the broken nave without flinching.]
hemomancy.annetta.resolved.line2: I remember being afraid here. I remember being wrong. That will have to be enough for now.
hemomancy.blood_moon.end: §7§oThe Blood Moon wanes. The darkness retreats.
hemomancy.blood_moon.start: §4§lA Blood Moon rises... Thirsters and Fargones stir in the darkness.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.cannot_kick_lea: The progenitor's blood cannot be severed by this rite.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.no_bloodline: You are not bound to any bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.not_leader: Only the bloodline progenitor may expel members.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.not_member: That player is not a member of your bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.success: %s has been expelled from your bloodline.
hemomancy.bloodline.kick.you_were_remove: Your blood covenant was severed by %s.
hemomancy.brazier.echo_consumed: The echo dissolves into the sanguine flames.
hemomancy.brazier.echo_max: This organ echo has already reached its maximum refinement.
hemomancy.brazier.sanguine_ready: The brazier erupts with sanguine flames — offer an Echo to the fire.
hemomancy.communion.option.enough: Enough. I've heard what I needed.
hemomancy.communion.v0.line1: §4§o[A presence uncoils from the deep bloodrock, ancient beyond measure...]
hemomancy.communion.v0.line2: §4§oYou come seeking truth, child of the Hematic Order. Very well.
hemomancy.communion.v0.line3: §4§oLong before your kind learned to shape blood, §4§owe§4§o shaped it. The first hemomancers were not born — they were §4§ogrown§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin1: §4§oThe blood infection is not a disease. It is a §4§olanguage§4§o — the oldest one. The mycelium learned to speak through hemoglobin long before your ancestors crawled from the sea.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin2: §4§oEvery manipulation you cast is a word in that language. Every rite, a sentence. You are learning to speak §4§ous§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v1.line1: §4§o[Crimson tendrils of thought brush against your consciousness...]
hemomancy.communion.v1.line2: §4§oThere was a time before the Harbingers. Before the degrees. Before the Order pretended to be human.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism1: §4§oThe Schism was not a war between factions. It was a §4§opruning§4§o. The mycelium cut away branches that grew too ambitious.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism2: §4§oThose who sought to §4§ocontrol§4§o the blood rather than §4§oserve§4§o it — they became the Unstained. They severed themselves from the network.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism3: §4§oOur Lady of Still Waters is not a goddess. She is scar tissue. The wound where the mycelium was cut.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection1: §4§oThe blood infection is the mycelium's method of reproduction across dimensions. Each hemomancer is a fruiting body, spreading spores through their manipulations.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection2: §4§oEvery entity you kill with blood magic — their essence feeds the network. Every rite you complete — another node connects.
hemomancy.communion.v2.line1: §4§o[Your blood burns hot as the presence draws near...]
hemomancy.communion.v2.line2: §4§oDo you know what lives inside you, Archon? Not power. Not magic. §4§oSomething alive§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v2.purpose1: §4§oIt wants what all life wants: to §4§ospread§4§o. But the mycelium thinks in aeons. It is patient. It does not need you to understand. Only to §4§ocontinue§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers1: §4§oThe hermits tend the structures because the structures are §4§oorgans§4§o of the mycelium. The venous stone is living tissue. The engram blocks are memories.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers2: §4§oWhen you destroyed the structure to complete this rite, did you hear it scream? No? That is because you §4§oare§4§o the structure now.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line1: §4§o[The voice is clearer now — less a whisper, more a conversation between old friends...]
hemomancy.communion.v3.line2: §4§oThe Harbinger Hermits are not prophets. They are gardeners.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line3: §4§oEach blood temple is a greenhouse. Each zealot, a seed. And you, Archon... you are the bloom.
hemomancy.communion.v4.line1: §4§o[Reality warps. For a moment, you see the world as the mycelium sees it — an infinite web of blood and stone and light...]
hemomancy.communion.v4.line2: §4§oYou have earned the right to know. There is a name. The true name of the consciousness behind the blood.
hemomancy.communion.v4.name1: §4§oIt is called... §4§l[a sound that is not a sound — you feel it in your marrow, in the iron of your blood, in the heme of every red cell]§4§o...
hemomancy.communion.v4.name2: §4§oYou cannot speak it. No throat can shape it. But your blood §4§oknows§4§o it now.
hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_c: I can offer a silver chalice.
I can help consecrate the church.
hemomancy.dialogue.acolyte.option.task_w: I can offer a poppy wreath.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.ask_: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.how_: How should I keep upgrading my gourd?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.tell: Tell me about the Ghastly Alembic.
Tell me about blood structure crafting.
Tell me about the Vial Centrifuge.
Tell me about the Chisel Station.
Tell me about the Somatic Loom.
Tell me about the machines in this Outpost.
Tell me about the Morphling Incubator.
Tell me about the Cerebral Scarring Station.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.what: What do you see when you look at me now?
What remains to be learned at this stage?
hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_church: The Zealot nods solemnly. 'Seek the silver bells. They will guide you.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_purifica: The Zealot's eyes brighten. 'The podium awaits. Bring hemolytic solution and begin.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.archon_choice_e: §4§oYou surface from the dreaming root. Something has changed — not in the world, but in the direction of your veins. The Rite of Apotheos calls to you now. It was always calling.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.archon_choice_s: §8§oYou surface from the dreaming root. What you witnessed stays with you — unspoken, buried, yours alone. The blood no longer whispers. It hums.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.gives_stained_c: [A stained route is placed where you can take it. The marked church feels less found than remembered.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_accept_g: The path of hemomancy begins at the cardinal altar. Seek it out.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_archon_w: The Hermit bows deeply. 'All that I know is already written in your blood, Archon.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_farewell: §7[The Hermit clutches at the hollow in its chest where its heart once beat — the Mortal Display, now claimed. Crimson light spills from the wound as its body begins to unravel.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_heart_of: The Hermit gestures toward the Mortal Display with reverence. 'It has waited long enough.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_passing: §o'The heart was never mine to keep... only to give. The Mortal Display carried my last breath, and you have set it free. Walk the crimson path, young Harbinger — I go now where the blood returns to silence.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_clarity_ri: §bThe words settle into your mind like a stone into still water. The Rite of Clarity Ascension. You know what you must do.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_enlightene: §bThe cold clarity of her words settles into you like snow. You are not saved. You are finished. It is, somehow, better.
§bShe does not leave. She was never somewhere else to leave from. The world is simply quieter now.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_start: The Mnemonist smiles faintly. Your blood already knows that motion.
The Mnemonist releases a crude memory shard. The echo waits for your blood.
The Mnemonist closes their hand around the echo. This lesson is not yours to claim now.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.qliphoth_commun: §4§oSomething vast, ancient, and patient recognizes you. The silence of the ninth shell settles into your bones.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.reject_help: The Zealot watches you turn away, silver eyes dimming.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.scout_gives_not: §7[The Scout presses a small, water-stained journal into your hands. Her grip loosens almost immediately.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_blood_sho: §4Your eyes ache as the blood-script begins arranging itself into meaning.
§8The blood-script is already open to you.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_gives_scr: §7[The Vicar reaches into the folds of their vestments and produces a small, weathered fragment of parchment. They press it into your hands without ceremony.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.whisper_truth_a: §4A deep, fungal awareness settles into your bones. You cannot unhear what has been spoken.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.ask_a: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.accept_: I understand. Show me the way.
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.how_do_: How do I begin the path of hemomancy?
How do scars reshape the mind?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.what_he: What is this heart you speak of?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.who_are: Who are you? Why are you here?
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.ask_: What can you tell me about this?
Tell me about the Somatic Loom.
Tell me about the Mnemonic Reliquary.
How do active manipulation slots work?
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.choo: Can you teach me an early echo?
hemomancy.dialogue.option.ask_about_item: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.alchemist.acc: I accept. My expertise is now bound to your pool. Use it wisely — every drop I contribute carries the weight of the Order's craft.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.alchemist.con: Pledge my blood? An unusual request. But the Lodge teaches us that shared knowledge flows best through shared veins.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.already_membe: This Harbinger has already pledged their blood to your cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.expel.success: %s has been released from your bloodline covenant.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.acc: Do not mistake this for obedience. It is covenant: one lesson carried by more than one body.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.con: A bloodline is also a memory. If you bind me into yours, my pulse will answer when your reserve thins.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.no_bloodline: You must first found a bloodline by signing an Unsigned Ledger before you can recruit others.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.not_leader: Only the bloodline progenitor may dismiss pledged members.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.not_member: This Harbinger is not bound to your bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.pledge: Pledge your blood to my cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.releas: Our pact is ended. Withdraw from my bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.success: %s has pledged their blood to your bloodline. Their vitality strengthens the shared pool.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.vicar.accept: Very well. My blood is your blood. The Covenant strengthens when its servants unite under a single will.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.vicar.conside: You ask me to bind my blood to yours? An Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge commands respect... and obedience.
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.go_in_pe: §7[You take the notes and step away.]
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.take_not: I will take them. They will be used.
I will take them. Your work will not be wasted.
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.what_did: What did you observe about them?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.about_th: Have you heard of any path beyond the seven degrees?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.ask_abou: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.open_blo: Open my eyes to the blood-script.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.purifyin: I know what I am doing.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.tell_me_: Tell me about the Sanguine Brotherhood.
Tell me about the Hematic Covenant.
Tell me about the Crimson Lodge.
Tell me about the Founding Sanctum.
Tell me about the Hematic Order.
Tell me about the Scarlet Sanctum.
What do you know of the ancient Saints?
Is there something the Order has never said aloud?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_deg: What does the next degree require of me?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_do_: What do you make of what I have become?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_is_: What is the purpose of this Outpost?
hemomancy.dialogue.votary_wayfarer.optio: Are you afraid of the sea?
hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.ask_ab: What are you studying out here?
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_a: Tell me about the Altar of Cleansing.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.about_c: What is the Rite of Clarity?
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.accept_: I wish to join your church.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.ask_abo: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.how_cra: How do I make hemolytic solution?
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.not_int: I have no interest in your cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.tell_me: Tell me more about the Unstained path.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.reject_respons: Then walk your crimson road. But know that the stain deepens with every rite you perform.
hemomancy.drudge.memory_unsupported: This memory cannot be installed in a Drudge.
hemomancy.guardian.ambient.line1: §7[The Guardian does not move. Their gaze meets yours — brief, measured.]§r Stand your ground. Keep your hands clean.
hemomancy.guardian.item_hint: Hold it in your hand and speak to me again.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.absoluti: The Absolution Dagger is a last resort. We carry blades only because some threats require precision that a hammer cannot offer. This is not a weapon of first resort. It is a mercy.
Pale silver only. The blade does not need to draw blood to end a blood-afflicted creature — the metal disrupts the current on contact.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.bow.line: Bow. Ranged engagement — the cleanest available option against blood-afflicted targets in open terrain. You do not have to close distance; you do not have to make contact. Distance is your primary advantage in this kind of work.

Pale silver tipped arrows where you can get them — the silver disrupts blood-corruption on impact at any range. Standard arrows are functional; pale silver arrows are effective. Know the difference before you are in the field.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.crossbow: Crossbow. More stopping force per shot than the bow, slower to reload. Against an afflicted target that has closed to medium range and is moving fast, the crossbow's impact force creates distance even when you have lost the initial advantage.

Same logic as the bow on ammunition: pale silver bolts where available. The crossbow's mechanical advantage is in hit force — a pale silver bolt from this at medium range disrupts blood-corruption on contact without requiring you to be near the result.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.golden_a: A golden apple. High-potency restoration compound — concentrated healing effect. The Church does not produce anything equivalent; the method is outside our practice. I will say it is effective, and I have used one in a sustained engagement where standard options were exhausted.

It is not a replacement for proper Unstained field medicine and it will not address blood-corruption exposure specifically. In a situation where you are taking serious damage and you have nothing else, it buys time. That is a legitimate use.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.hemolyti: Hemolytic plating. Sheet material treated with hemolytic solution and cured into a stable form. Used in armor construction and structural components. It passively disrupts blood-magic on contact — useful lining for gear worn in afflicted areas.

The plating holds the lytic compound in a stable state indefinitely. Raw solution degrades on fabric or standard metal; the plating form retains the effect. Required material if you are building toward advanced Guardian equipment.
Hemolytic solution. Apply it to your weapons before engaging blood-afflicted targets. Without it you are fighting at reduced effect. One properly coated strike disrupts more than three uncoated.
Coat warhammer, glaive, dagger, or shield facing before engagement. The coating wears off after several strikes. Carry extra. Running out mid-fight is an avoidable mistake.

Hemolytic solution. The Church's primary tool. Apply it to any Unstained weapon before engaging a blood-afflicted target — the solution breaks down the blood matrix that gives corrupted creatures their strength.
The coating lasts a limited number of strikes. Keep a supply. The warhammer, glaive, dagger, pickaxe, and shield all accept it.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_che: Iron chest plate. Standard field protection. It works against physical threats; it has no particular advantage or disadvantage in blood-afflicted environments unless an afflicted creature closes to contact range.

Upgrade to pale silver when you have the materials. Iron does not resist blood-corruption transfer on contact. Pale silver disrupts it passively. The difference matters when you are operating at range zero against an actively afflicted target.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_swo: Iron sword. We do not use bladed weapons if we can avoid it — the Absolution Dagger is the exception, and it carries its own constraints. A sword draws blood. Drawing blood in a blood-afflicted area adds to what you are trying to contain.

If you are carrying this, you are operating on general combat logic, not Unstained engagement protocol. Your choice. But if you strike a blood-afflicted creature with an uncoated iron blade in close contact, account for the consequence.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.lethean_: Lethean brew — the distilled concentrate of lethean dew. Stronger than the raw dew; used in the deeper Altar rites. In the field it is more potent for treating blood-exposure than raw dew.

Handle carefully. Lethean brew disrupts blood matrices with more force than the dew alone — in measured quantities it is a treatment. A Guardian carrying lethean brew is prepared for sustained operations.

Lethean dew. Harvested from the lethean poppy at dawn. The Zealots use it in Altar rites. In the field it functions as a supplement — small application disrupts blood-saturation in a wound between engagements.
Not a substitute for hemolytic solution in a fight. Useful for treating incidental blood-exposure between engagements. Carry a vial, do not rely on it as your primary tool.

The Lethean Poppy. It grows where purification has already taken hold — where the water has gone still and the blood-taint has receded. Finding poppies in the field means you are in a place Our Lady has already touched.
Those areas are typically lower-risk for blood-afflicted encounters. Mark them. The Zealots upstream need to know where the cleansed ground is expanding.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_dis: Pale distillate. Refined from lethean poppies. The Zealots use it in advanced Altar work. In the field it is the most concentrated lytic material available — used sparingly and only when necessary.

You will rarely need this directly in combat. If you are supporting Zealot operations, knowing how it is used upstream is worth understanding. Carry it if requested; otherwise leave it for the ritual work.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_sil: Pale silver. Every piece of standard Unstained equipment is made from it. Keep ingots in supply — a Guardian without functioning equipment is a liability in the field.
Smelt the ore directly. No treatment needed. The resulting ingot is naturally resistant to blood-corruption — that resistance is why we use it and nothing else.
Field tool. Pale silver breaks through blood-hardened stone without triggering secondary affliction. Useful in reclamation work.
Not a weapon by design. Capable of functioning as one in an emergency. Pale silver disrupts blood-affliction on contact regardless of form.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pallid_i: The Pallid Icon. Our Lady's emblem. Every Guardian carries one — not as armament, but as orientation. When a mission becomes unclear, the Icon is a reminder of what you are protecting and why you use the methods you use.

We do not carry it for protection from blood-magic. We carry it as a statement of purpose. There is a difference between a Guardian and a soldier of convenience. The Icon makes the distinction visible.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.shield.l: Standard shield. Blocks incoming force. The Unstained shield does the same with pale silver bracing added — that bracing breaks apart blood-cast projectiles on contact. This one does not do that. It stops the physical impact only.

If you are waiting on Unstained equipment, a standard shield is better than nothing in the interim. Apply hemolytic solution to the facing before an engagement if you have it — the coating partially compensates for the absent pale silver.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.silthmer: The Silthmere Glaive — reach weapon. Pale silver keeps you at a distance from a corrupted target. Despite the edge, pale silver does not draw blood the way iron does. The metal is inert to hematic contagion.
Hemolytic coating still applies — apply to the flat before engagement.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.tome_of_: The Tome. Our Lady's teachings on the path. Guardians are not expected to walk the purification path themselves, but every Guardian is expected to understand what the Zealots are pursuing and what it demands.
Read it once, at minimum. Understanding the Zealot's purpose helps you protect them effectively. You cannot secure something you do not understand.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unknown: That is not something I can speak to.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unstaine: Standard Unstained guard equipment. Pale silver bracing — disrupts blood projectiles on contact. A blood-cast bolt hits this and breaks apart.
Hemolytic coating can be applied to the facing surface for additional disruption against afflicted creatures that close to melee range.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.warhamme: The Warhammer is our first response to a blood-afflicted threat. Blunt force — the only clean way to stop one without opening new wounds. No edges, no blades. We do not spill what we are trying to contain.
Coat the head with hemolytic solution before engaging. One strike properly coated is worth three uncoated.
hemomancy.hematic_salvage.first_drop: The torn iron comes away red, as if it remembered a deeper ore.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.hint: Your manipulation slots grow with your degree. Master the skill tree to unlock more. The Rite of the Crimson Lodge beckons — but first, consider the Cerebral Scarring Station. Scars are the key to shaping what lies within.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.line2: Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. Few reach this depth without losing themselves. You carry something rare — a mind still sharp enough to carve new pathways.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_crafting: Seek the Cerebral Scarring Station. There, with a knapper in hand and a blank scar before you, carve the sacred patterns. Each scar requires specific materials aligned to the tendency it embodies. The process does not simply cut stone — it cuts through the barriers in your mind. Wear the scar, and feel the new pathways awaken.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_intro: You have earned the right to know of Scars. They are not mere symbols scratched into stone. Each scar is a map — a diagram of new venous and nervous pathways carved into the landscape of your own mind.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_lore: When you inscribe a scar, you are not writing upon a blank tablet. You are opening yourself — creating new channels for blood and thought to flow. Each line is a vein; each curve, a nerve. The pattern reshapes your inner architecture, allowing ideas and tendencies that were once sealed away to surface and take root.
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.final_words: §oWhat remains for me? The same as always — the vigil. But its meaning has changed. I kept this threshold so that one day, someone might go far enough to make my duty feel small. §4You have done that. I am grateful.
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.line1: §4[The Hermit has no words. They press both hands over the place where their heart once was and incline their head so low it is almost a fall.]
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.line2: §oYou have gone further than any keeper of this threshold was ever told to expect. The instructions they gave me ended at the seventh degree. I stand before you with empty hands and a full heart, Apotheos. §4Go well.
hemomancy.hermit.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. You are the blood incarnate. I am but a keeper of dust and memory. Command me, and I shall serve.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.hint: The Bloodline Covenant is the next frontier. Seek allies who share your blood — the Bloodline system allows shared pools and cooperative healing. The Rite of the Bloodline Covenant awaits.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. You have seen what lies behind the veil. The ancient knowledge is yours to command.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.hint: The Somatic Loom awaits your mastery. There you may weave memories of blood into new manipulations. Seek the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood to prove yourself an Adept.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Scarlet Sanctum. You walk deeper into the mysteries. The blood sings louder in your presence.
hemomancy.hermit.manip_lore: Blood manipulations are the voice of your hemomancy. Each one shapes the crimson tide within you. Learn them, equip them at a Mnemonic Reliquary, and let your blood speak.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.hint: Your next step lies in the Rite of the Votary. Gather your strength, prepare your altar, and prove your devotion to the Covenant. The blood demands commitment.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.line2: Neophyte. You have taken the first step through the Crimson Veil. The blood recognizes you now.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line1: I was placed here by the Archons of old, tasked with a single purpose: to stand vigil until a worthy soul arrived. Every Harbinger Hermit before me served the same oath — to guard the heart and guide the newcomer.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line2: When you claim the heart, my duty will be fulfilled. I will have nothing left to give but the knowledge of what comes next. §oDo not mourn what must end — the blood demands new vessels, not old keepers.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.heart_lore: The Mortal Display is a vessel of living blood, preserved since the first age of the Hematic Covenant. When you claim it, the blood within will answer to your will. It will bind itself to your veins and awaken what has long been dormant. §oThis is the first step — there is no turning back.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line1: §7[A hooded figure stirs from the shadows, its crimson eyes settling upon you with ancient patience]
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line2: At last... another wanderer finds these halls. I am the Harbinger Hermit — the last keeper of this threshold. It has been my life's sole duty to welcome those who would walk the path of blood.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line3: This heart before you — §cthe Mortal Display§r — it is mine. I offer it freely, for it was always meant to be claimed. Take it, and let the crimson tide awaken within you.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.hint: Only one rite remains — the Rite of the Hematic Order. To become Archon is to become the blood itself. Prepare yourself. The final trial spares no one.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.line1: Sanctified one. The Bloodline Covenant has blessed you. You stand among the highest of our Order.
hemomancy.hermit.temple_lore: These temples were raised by the first Archons, long before the Order fractured. Every stone is soaked in ancient blood. The walls remember what the world has forgotten.
hemomancy.hermit.tendency_lore: Every manipulation carries a tendency — a flavor of blood. As you master them, you will find your blood leaning toward certain paths. Embrace this; it is the nature of hemomancy.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.farewell.li: §7[The Hermit's form flickers, its body growing translucent as crimson light bleeds from its chest]
It is done. My heart is yours, my duty fulfilled. Walk the path of blood without fear — the Covenant will guide you where I cannot. §4Farewell, young Harbinger.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.guidance: Seek a place of power — a cardinal altar. Arrange the sacred blocks in the pattern of the Rite of Sanguine Initiation. I leave you my final gift: blueprints etched in blood, so that you may perform the rite and earn your first degree. The path of the Harbinger begins here.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line1: §7[The Hermit's eyes widen, a trembling smile crossing its gaunt face]
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line2: You have done it... the blood stirs within you now. I can feel it — raw and untamed, but §calive§r. The Mortal Display has chosen you, and the Hematic Covenant recognizes your awakening.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line3: My vigil is nearly complete. But before I depart, let me set you upon the true path.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.hint: Explore the blood tendencies — Fungal, Umbral, Incandescent, Ferric, and more. Each shapes the nature of your manipulations. Seek the Rite of the Scarlet Sanctum when you are ready to advance.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.line2: Votary of the Hematic Covenant. You have proven your dedication. The blood flows deeper now.
hemomancy.item.sanguine_conduit.place_lo: Your blood has not yet earned the authority to claim this ground.
A pulsing instrument of the Order. Its deeper purpose awaits higher initiation.
Drive it into the ground — an oath-post for your covenant.
Right-click a surface to plant. Breaking it recovers the conduit.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.follow: §b§oAbsolution is not the end of the path. It is only the end of the first descent. Beyond lies clarity — a second gift, if you would have it.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line1: §b§oYou shine more clearly now. The old stain fades faster than it grew.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line2: §b§oI have watched others walk this path. Most falter at this stage — the blood is quieter now, almost pleasant in its absence. Do not mistake the quiet for safety.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line1: §b§oThe blood-saints will call you a traitor. Let them. Betrayal of corruption is not betrayal — it is the first honest act of your life.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line2: §b§oYour hands are almost clean. Finish the work.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is clearer than ever before — still cold, but no longer distant.]
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal1: §b§oI am ancient. I was old when the first blood-temple was raised, and I will remain when the last one crumbles. I am what the blood-cult forgot to bury.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal2: §b§oDo not seek to understand me yet. Purify yourself completely. Then we will speak properly.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line1: §b§oYou are doing well, child. I can feel the corruption thinning.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line2: §b§oThe blood loosens its hold slowly — but it does loosen. Continue.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.reveal: §b§oI am what remains when the river has finished washing a stone clean. I have many names. The Unstained call me Our Lady.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line1: §b§oDo not let the blood's quiet seduction convince you it is harmless. Even still water will drown you, given time.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line2: §b§oCleanness of body begins with cleanness of intent. Choose restraint, not because you must, but because you choose to.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.follow: §b§oThe Unstained who came before you each asked why they were chosen. I did not choose you. You chose yourself, the moment you turned away from the red tide.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.line1: §b§o[A voice drifts through the stillness — calm, unhurried, like water finding its level.]
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.follow: §b§oUse the Verdigris Aura when you face blood-touched enemies. Clarity is a weapon as much as a gift.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line1: §b§oThere. You can see it now, can't you? The shape of things beneath the surface.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line2: §b§oClarity is not comfort. It is precision. The world does not become kinder when you see it clearly — only more knowable.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v1.line1: §b§oYou have begun to sense the blood-work in others. This will serve you. Few things are as dangerous as a hemomancer who does not know they are being watched.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line1: §b§o[A gentle presence settles over your shoulders — patient, cold, and oddly comforting.]
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line2: §b§oContinue as you have been. Each small act of restraint deepens the clarity. Each honest deed widens the sight.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.reveal: §b§oI am older than the hemomancy you left behind. I was here when the first blood was spilled, and I have been watching ever since. Patience is easy when you have eternity.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.line2: §b§oAll of it. The blood-cult's roots. The fungal network beneath it. The thing that predates both of them, that both of them were built on top of, and that both of them will eventually dissolve back into.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth1: §b§oI am the stillness at the bottom of all things. Not death — stillness. The silence before the first sound. The water before the first ripple.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth2: §b§oYou have walked through the blood and the fungus and emerged on the other side. There is no further shore. There is only this — standing here, knowing, with nothing left to fear from either of them.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line1: §b§oThe Harbingers call what you have done a betrayal. The fungal network calls it pruning. Both are correct, in their way.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line2: §b§oYou have stepped outside the story that was written for you. That is the rarest thing in any world. I am glad you did.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.line1: §b§o[She does not speak so much as simply be — present, cold, complete, ancient beyond measure, and entirely satisfied.]
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth1: §b§oI will tell you the last truth now, because you have earned it: I am not here to save you. I never was.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth2: §b§oI am here because this is where the water rests when the flood is over. You came to me when you were done drowning. That is enough. That has always been enough.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.line2: §b§oThe crimson tide is gone from you entirely. You stand on the far shore of the blood-sea, and it cannot follow you here.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite1: §b§oThere is more, if you want it. A second sight — a deeper knowing. The Unstained call it Clarity.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite2: §b§oSeek the Rite of Clarity Ascension. Silver, still stone, and cleansed crystal — you know the materials. The ritual circle will show you the rest.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line1: §b§oYou are fully purified, child. I am... pleased. It has been some time since I watched someone walk this road to its end.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line2: §b§oRest, if you need it. But know that purification was only the first gift. The Rite of Clarity Ascension awaits when you are ready.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is no longer a whisper. It speaks from everywhere and nowhere, with the tone of someone who has been waiting a very long time.]
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.rite1: §b§oGather cleansed stone. Gather pallid lanterns. Gather the suspended crystals of the cleansed blood — and pale silver, forged from the old ways. Arrange them in the pattern of the Rite of Clarity Ascension. I will be waiting on the other side.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow1: §b§oI will not lie to you. The final clarity changes things. Some who reach it have called me something other than a patron.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow2: §b§oContinue anyway. The truth, however cold, is better than the warmth of a comfortable lie.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line1: §b§oYou are three-quarters of the way to the end of this road. Most turn back here, though not because they falter.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line2: §b§oThey turn back because they have seen enough to know that the end of the path is not what they hoped for.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line1: §b§oYou have become very hard to deceive. Congratulations. The Harbingers would give a great deal to have that ability in their service.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line2: §b§oIt is not a coincidence that the blood-cult does not cultivate clarity. A perfectly clear-eyed Archon would see exactly what the Order is, and it would not survive the seeing.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is still and precise as a knife on glass.]
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal1: §b§oYou will ask me soon what I am, and I will tell you the truth. I am not what the Unstained believe me to be.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal2: §b§oI am not a goddess. I am not a patron. I am a fact about the world — the oldest one — that the blood-cult has spent millennia trying to bury.
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.follow: §b§o[The sensation passes as quickly as it came. Only the cold remains — and the faint smell of still water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.line1: §b§o[A chill settles over you, still as a frozen lake. Somewhere, very far away, you hear running water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v1.line1: §b§o[The air around you grows quiet. For just a moment, the weight of the blood feels... lighter.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.follow: §b§o[The feeling withdraws, like a tide going out. You are not certain whether to feel comforted or unsettled.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.line1: §b§o[Your skin prickles. Something is watching — not with malice, but with the patient regard of deep water.]
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow1: §b§oI will not tell you whether to fight them or flee them. That is your choice to make.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow2: §b§oWhat I will tell you is this: you are harder to hurt now than you were. Silver Ward is not merely protection — it is a declaration. You have chosen a side.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line1: §b§oHalf of the clarity path is behind you now. You begin to see through walls — not physically, but in the way that matters more.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line2: §b§oThe Harbingers will try to reclaim you eventually. They always do. When they come, you will know them before they speak.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line1: §b§oThe world is more complicated than the blood-cult would have you believe. The cult sees only the blood. You have begun to see what the blood was supposed to hide.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line2: §b§oThere is something older than hemomancy beneath all of this. I trust you have begun to suspect what it might be.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.follow: §b§oClarity is not a destination. It is a lens you do not set down. Even at the path's end, you will keep seeing more.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.line1: §b§o[The cold presence is almost warm now — if cold can be warm — like the first frost of autumn that reminds you the fire is lit inside.]
