hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line1: The silence around you is bright. Painfully bright.
hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line2: Ask, if you must. I remember the path you left, but I will not hand its living lessons back to you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line1: Crude memories are early echoes. Use one, pay the blood cost, and the manipulation settles into your known lessons.
hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line2: If you have an empty active slot, the echo will step into it on its own. If every slot is full, it waits in your library until you learn to arrange yourself.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_hint: Hold the object you want named. If it has memory in it, or touches memory's practice, I will tell you what listens back.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.crude_m: Blood Lamp. Lux makes witness of the dark.
A humble echo, and a good one. Light is often the first mercy a Harbinger learns to make.
Blood Rush. The body remembers panic and calls it speed.
Use it as an early lesson in movement, but mind the cost. Fast blood is still blood spent.
Blood Shot. A simple lesson: pressure, release, and a line drawn through the air.
Let it teach you only after initiation. If an active slot is empty, it will rise to the surface by itself.
Crimson Harvest. Ductilis remembers work: draw, gather, take what the vein can use.
A good field lesson. It teaches the blood that utility can be as sacred as violence.
Deadly Gaze. An ugly little echo, but useful: intent carried through the eyes before the hand moves.
It is crude, not harmless. Look carefully at anything you teach your blood to hate.
Glacial Grasp. Congeatio slows the world until a mistake can be studied.
A cold lesson, but not an unfeeling one. Stillness can save you.
Hemorrhage. Mortem knows how endings begin: a small opening, then insistence.
Treat this lesson with restraint. The blood keeps cruel habits easily.
Sanguine Ignition. Flammeus remembers fever, spark, and the red thought before flame.
It is eager. Do not let eagerness masquerade as mastery.
Sanguine Mending. Ferric memory is fond of repair, though it asks payment first.
Do not call it kindness. It is an exchange between wound and reserve.
Void Shroud. Tenebris teaches the blood to pull the dark close and breathe quietly beneath it.
Some lessons hide you from enemies. Some hide you from yourself. Learn the difference.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.hematic: A blank hematic memory is a cup waiting for a voice.
The Loom can fill it with a deliberate lesson, if your degree and materials are ready.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.memory_: Blood Absorption. Utility, yes, but do not mistake utility for weakness.
This lesson teaches you to draw what spilled power remains. It belongs early, when every reserve matters.
Blood Projection. The outward hand of the same first doctrine.
Absorb and project: intake and offering. Most Harbingers learn those two before they learn pride.
A refined Blood Rush memory. It has fewer burrs than the crude shard and spends its lesson more cleanly.
Do not forget the crude version that taught your body how to begin.
A refined Blood Shot memory. Cleaner than a scraped echo, but still the same first line of force.
Full memories obey their rank gates. The crystal may be ready before the practitioner is.
A refined Deadly Gaze memory. The lesson has been given shape instead of scraped from old panic.
Refinement makes a memory stable. It does not make it innocent.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.mnemoni: The Mnemonic Reliquary arranges your active manipulation loadout.
It does not teach new lessons. It decides which known lessons wait nearest the pulse.
The Reliquary is for the second degree and beyond. Until then, let the first crude lessons settle where they can.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.salt_st: Salt ruins paper faster than blood ruins memory. Hold it still. There: current marks, specimen counts, a prayer before descent.
The last line is not a secret. It is a request: if we do not surface, make use of what we learned.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.somatic: The Somatic Loom weaves deliberate blood memories from tendency inputs, blood, and pattern.
A crude shard is a found echo. A Loom-woven crystal is a lesson made on purpose.
The Somatic Loom will not open its discipline to you before the third degree. Scraped echoes must carry you a little longer.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.unknown: That object has no lesson I can hear. Or it is wise enough to keep quiet.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line1: The Somatic Loom is where scraped echoes give way to deliberate weaving.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line2: Tendency inputs, blood, and pattern decide what lesson crystallizes. Full memories obey rank gates; not every crystal should be opened by an early vein.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line1: Blood-memory is not a book on a shelf. It is inheritance, infection, rehearsal, and hunger braided together.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line2: A memory crystal gives the pattern a mouth. A crude shard is only a whisper, but a whisper can still teach the first motion.
hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line1: Neophyte. There you are. The first echoes have begun to gather around you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line2: Crude does not mean false. A crude memory is a scraped lesson, rough at the edges, but the blood keeps what the hand forgets.
hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line1: §7[The Mnemonist's eyes soften, but their hands fold closed.]
hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line2: You are trying to loosen the lessons from your blood. I will answer questions, but I will not press another echo into a wound you are trying to clean.
hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line1: The Mnemonic Reliquary is not a teacher. It is a careful shelf for the lessons you have already survived.
hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line2: Use it to arrange your active loadout. It changes readiness, not ownership; the deeper library remains in you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line1: Your active manipulation slots are not your whole memory. They are the lessons your body can keep near the surface without tearing itself open.
hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line2: Early crude lessons may fill empty slots for you. Later, the Reliquary lets you decide which lessons sleep close to the pulse.
hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line1: Take one early echo, and only one from my hand. The rest you must find where the old walls still remember.
hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line2: Choose by instinct: reach, motion, or gaze.
hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line1: §7[A robed Harbinger presses two fingers to their own wrist, listening to a pulse you cannot hear.]
hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line2: Not yet. The blood remembers many lessons, but it does not open its mouth for an uncut heir. Return after initiation, and I will teach you how to listen without being drowned.
hemomancy.mnemonist.votary.line1: Votary. Your active lessons should no longer be accidents. Soon the Reliquary will teach you to choose what waits closest to the vein.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line1: Your blood has learned enough words that simple echoes are no longer enough.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line2: The Loom does not scrape memory from old walls. It weaves deliberate lessons, thread by thread, until a crystal can teach without speaking.
hemomancy.monolith.archon.press_again: §7[The surface is warm enough now that it is uncomfortable to hold your hand against.]§r Press here again. Not many more times remain.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.adept: Adept, the Brotherhood recognises your blood. Seek the Sainted Mausoleums and draw from the preserved corpus within. The enzymes of Saints hold the key to the next rite.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.adept.line1: §7[The surface hums faintly beneath your palm. You are not sure if it is machinery or something older.]
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.adept.line2: Adept. The Brotherhood recognises your blood. Seek the Sainted Mausoleums — draw from the preserved corpus within. The enzymes of the Saints hold what you need next.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon: Archon... under your power the monolith begins to crack. Press further, and it may shatter into black shards.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon.line1: I have been waiting for you specifically. Not someone like you — §oyou§r.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon.line2: §7[A low sound comes from somewhere deep inside the stone. Not mechanical. Not settling. Something else.]
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.illuminatus: Illuminatus, the Crimson Lodge has opened its gates. Delve deeper into the crimson fungal depths and commune with the Dendritic Distributors. The mycelial network whispers of dormant power.
§7[The stone is faintly warm where you touch it. That is new.]
Illuminatus. The Lodge's gates stand open. The mycelial network below your feet whispers of dormant power. You are beginning to hear it, I think.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.sanctified: Sanctified of the Covenant, few have walked this far. Seek the living constructs — fuse organ and engram upon the Somatic Loom. Shape flesh as others shape stone.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.sanctified.l: §7[Beneath your palm, the stone does not feel like stone.]
Sanctified of the Covenant. Very few have stood where you stand. Fuse organ to engram on the Somatic Loom — shape flesh as others only work stone.
hemomancy.monolith.unworthy: The monolith is silent. Its surface is cold and unyielding — you have not yet proven yourself worthy.
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.adept: A lodestone of the Order, built by the Crimson Lodge in the Second Age. It remembers every Harbinger who has stood before it. Every degree. Every name.
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.archon: You are close enough now that I can be direct. What is inside me recognises what is inside you. We are, in some sense, the same thing.
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.illumina: I was built to measure. That is what the Lodge believed. The truth is slightly different.
hemomancy.monolith.what_are_you.sanctifi: I contain something. I always have. The Lodge sealed it here because they did not know what else to do with it.
hemomancy.mortal_display.charm_equipped: A living adornment has latched itself around your neck, marking you as destined for the path of the harbinger.
hemomancy.occulus.task.adept: Strengthen the Covenant — command the crimson tide through advanced manipulations and perform the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood.
hemomancy.occulus.task.archon: The Rite of the Hematic Order awaits. Become an Archon — the highest degree the blood-tide can bestow.
hemomancy.occulus.task.illuminatus: Ascend to Illuminatus — the Rite of the Crimson Lodge demands deeper devotion and greater mastery of blood.
hemomancy.occulus.task.initiate: Attune to the blood tendencies and perform the Rite of the Scarlet Sanctum to advance in the Hematic Order.
hemomancy.occulus.task.neophyte: Perform the Rite of Sanguine Initiation at a cardinal altar to earn your first degree as a Harbinger.
hemomancy.occulus.task.sanctified: Prove your mastery — the Rite of the Bloodline Covenant will elevate you to the Sanctified rank.
hemomancy.occulus.task.votary: Master blood manipulations and earn the Rite of the Votary to deepen your covenant with the blood.

hemomancy.rite.lethean_tide.desc: A purifying tide that washes the crimson from the sky, ending an active Blood Moon and granting a surge of purity. Requires purity of 50 or greater.
hemomancy.rite.moon_washed_copper.desc: A reusable Unstained rite that deepens clarity through verdigris moonlight and teaches Quietus Bell, with Autoimmune Edge answering only at Enlightenment.

hemomancy.scout.farewell.line1: §o...Good.§r §7[She exhales slowly and closes her eyes. The hand holding the journal goes still.]
hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line1: They behave exactly as they do outside. Looking for food, pressing the walls, circling one another. But they never registered me as a threat. §oNot a threat. Not prey. Nothing.§r
hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line2: In the church, Annetta always complained about them. Said they got into everything. Said she tried every ward and they still found their way past her. She called them a plague. That struck me as odd — wards that hold back Chthonians should hold back anything.
hemomancy.scout.observation_hint.line3: §oThink about what that means for her.§r I wrote it in the notes. It is there, if you can use it.
hemomancy.scout.root.line1: §7[An Unstained woman is slumped against the bone-speckled wall of the geode, her robes filthy with stone dust. She raises her eyes to you — glassy, but focused.]
hemomancy.scout.root.line2: Oh. §o...Someone found me.§r I have not much left. Cold, and hunger — they do what the creatures in here never managed. Please. I have notes — observations — they must not go to waste. Take them before I cannot hand them over.
hemomancy.scout.root.line3: §oDo not let the work be wasted.§r
hemomancy.scout.what_happened.line1: I came in after the creatures. The Order scouts them — tries to understand what they are, what they eat, whether they can be reasoned with. I spent a day inside, taking notes. Then the exit collapsed. §oI never found it again.§r
hemomancy.scout.what_happened.line2: But the bugs. They never touched me. Not once. I have been alone with them for three days now and — they simply look through me. I wrote it all down. I do not know what it means, but I know it §omatters§r.
hemomancy.silver_bells.already_pure: The bells toll softly. Your purification is already complete.
hemomancy.silver_bells.already_rung: The pale silver bells are quiet now; their blessing has already been spent.
hemomancy.silver_bells.chimed: §bThe pale silver bells ring across the sky. A great wave of purity floods your blood.
hemomancy.silver_bells.not_on_path: The pale silver bells do not answer you.

hemomancy.unstained.clarity_progress: Clarity: %.0f/100 — The path to enlightenment sharpens...

hemomancy.unstained.enlightened: You have achieved Enlightenment. You are Unstained.
hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_blocked: Your purified blood refuses to obey.
hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_weakene: Your purifying blood resists the manipulation...
hemomancy.unstained.not_ready: The podium waits for those whose blood needs cleansing.
hemomancy.unstained.purification_begun: The hemolytic solution sears through your veins... the cleansing has begun.
hemomancy.unstained.purity_complete: Your blood is cleansed. You are pure. Seek the Rite of Clarity.
hemomancy.unstained.too_deep: The podium remains cold. The blood has rooted too deeply for this cure.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.brotherhood_lore: The Sanguine Brotherhood was born from necessity — in the early wars of the Harbinger Order, practitioners who shared their blood pools survived engagements that should have killed them. Over time, shared blood became doctrine. The Brotherhood is not merely a rank; it is a philosophy. Blood flows where it is most needed, not where it is most jealously kept.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.degree_hint: The Rite of the Crimson Lodge stands between you and Illuminatus. The Lodge is the inner circle of the Order — those who have pierced beyond the surface of hemomancy and seen its underlying architecture. The Lodge's rite demands that you demonstrate understanding of the deeper patterns. Study your skill tree. The paths between skills are as important as the skills themselves.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.line1: §7[The Vicar places a hand over their heart in a formal salute]
hemomancy.vicar.adept.line2: Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. You have learned that blood, shared willingly, is stronger than blood hoarded alone. This is one of the Covenant's oldest truths.
hemomancy.vicar.annetta_map.line1: Annetta's old chapel was struck from our route ledgers after the last inquiry. Not destroyed. Removed. That is a different kind of burial.
hemomancy.vicar.annetta_map.line2: If you must follow that stain, take this. Do not mistake fear for innocence, and do not mistake infection for guilt.
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.line1: §4[The Vicar's breath catches. They cannot hold your gaze for more than a moment.]
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.line2: Apotheos. §oI do not have a word for what you are now. The doctrine ends at Archon. Everything beyond it — I have only rumour, and silence, and the sense that the silence is inhabited.
hemomancy.vicar.apotheos.reflection: §oThe Covenant was always meant to be outlived. I know that now. It is a ladder; what you have become is what was always at the top of it. I confess I do not know whether to bow or to mourn. §4§oBoth, perhaps.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.final_truth: §4§oI confess, Archon: I do not know what the Monolith has shown you. §rI was entrusted with seven degrees of doctrine — nothing beyond. The Monolith was placed to guide those the written word could no longer reach, and it does not share its counsel with Vicars. §4§oI have nothing left to offer you but the Covenant's oldest farewell. §rGo in blood.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line1: §4[The Vicar lowers their gaze in the deepest gesture of formal reverence]
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. The doctrine I have kept for so long... it is for those still climbing. You have arrived at the truth itself. I have nothing left to tell you that you do not already know in your blood.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.pome_empowered.li: §4[The Vicar pauses mid-bow. Their nose twitches almost imperceptibly.]
You smell like the deep forest after rain. Not the fresh kind.
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.done: §7[The blood burns cold. For a moment every line in the world grows roots, then settles back into letters.]
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.line1: §7[The Vicar studies your eyes, then pricks one finger with a thumbnail. The drop that gathers is too dark to be ordinary blood.]
hemomancy.vicar.blood_script.line2: There are words the Order lets you see before it lets you understand. Abocipher is one of them. A few drops, placed beneath the lid, will teach your eyes to stop rejecting the blood-script. It is not wisdom. It is only sight.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant_lore: The Hematic Covenant is the body of rites, traditions, and accumulated wisdom that has governed the practice of hemomancy since the First Age. Each degree of initiation corresponds to a rite that proves the practitioner has internalized a new level of understanding. The rites are not arbitrary trials — they are mirrors. They show you what you have become.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.degree_hint: The Rite of the Bloodline Covenant remains. To become Sanctified, you must formalize your blood bonds — not just share a pool, but commit to a bloodline with permanent oaths. The Covenant regards bloodline bonds as sacred contracts. They are not entered lightly, and they cannot be dissolved without cost.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.founding_san: The Illuminatus rite yields a Sanguine Quintessence — a distillate of your degree of attainment, made material. With it, and with the blood of your chosen ground, you may perform a founding rite that consecrates an area as a Harbinger Sanctum. Five chunks in every direction will answer to the Covenant's will. Harbingers within that boundary feel the blood move more freely — stronger regeneration, faster cooling of the rites, more potent strikes. The Sanctum is not a building. It is a declaration. If you have allies, bring them inside it.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. The veil has parted for you. What you now see about the nature of blood cannot be unseen.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.lodge_lore: The Crimson Lodge is the repository of the Order's most guarded knowledge. It was the Lodge that first documented the link between hemomancy and the underlying mycelial network — the discovery that blood and the living earth are part of the same organism. The Lodge's Archons do not speak of this openly. They believe the knowledge must be arrived at independently to be truly understood.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.monolith_rum: §7[The Vicar's composure shifts — something between discomfort and reverence crosses their face for a moment before they smooth it away]§r There are... rumors. Very old ones. The kind the Lodge does not put to parchment because no one alive has confirmed them.

Harbingers of an earlier age — centuries before my Vicariate — are said to have found a means of ascending further. Beyond the seven degrees. Beyond what the Covenant's doctrine covers. I cannot tell you how. I do not know. What I have is this — a fragment I found pressed inside an old reliquary. I cannot read all of it. It is not in any dialect I was trained in. But perhaps you can make more of it than I could.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.scrap_given: Take it. If it means something to you, then it was meant to find you. I have carried it long enough.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.degree_hint: The Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood awaits you. It is a rite of shared blood — of proving that your hemomancy can be wielded not just for yourself but in concert with others. Study the Bloodline system. The Brotherhood's rite demands understanding of what it means to share a blood pool.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Scarlet Sanctum. The blood does not merely flow in you now — it speaks. The Sanctum has recognized something in you that most never develop.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.saints_lore: There are Hemomancers from ages past whose power grew so vast the Order could not inter them as ordinary dead. They were sealed — living, or nearly so — in Trial Chambers, preserved by the blood that still moves in them. We call them Saints, though the word carries none of its common meaning here. Seek them out. The Hallowed Residuum in their veins, processed through the Centrifuge, yields something the Somatic Loom alone cannot produce — Canon Memories: blood patterns so ancient they predate the Order itself. Their tendencies will tell you whether to enter in peace or in combat.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.sanctum_lore: The Scarlet Sanctum was founded in the Second Age by the Archon Erythravane, who believed that hemomancy required not just power but discipline of mind. The Sanctum's rites were designed to break practitioners who relied on raw force and rebuild them as precision instruments. Every Initiate carries Erythravane's legacy whether they know it or not.
hemomancy.vicar.item_hint: Hold it in your hand and speak to me again.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.blood_struc: A blood structure schematic. The Covenant uses these patterns — arrangements of specific blocks — to draw power from accumulated blood and shape it into something functional. A blood key activates the completed pattern.
Lay the blocks precisely, strike the key against the central point with enough blood in reserve, and the structure assembles itself.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line1: A book. Written knowledge, preserved for transmission. The Covenant keeps extensive records — the degree rites, the tendency histories, the observations of practitioners across generations. A blank book in attentive hands is the beginning of something worth reading.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line2: The Order's most enduring work was not done by those with the strongest blood. It was done by those who understood what they were doing clearly enough to write it down for the practitioners who came after them.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.dendritic_d: The Dendritic Distributor. The Covenant's instrument for managing a practitioner's development. The Distributor maps your current vascular state and shows you what you have earned and what remains ahead.
At each new degree, additional branches of the skill tree become accessible. The Covenant has found that practitioners who take time to consolidate earlier skills perform better in the rites ahead.
The Dragon Egg. The Order has catalogued this. An immense amount of latent vitality compressed into a single crystalline form — a concentration of life-potential that rivals anything the blood produces through natural means.

The Covenant has not yet found a formal degree-rite application for it. That may change. At your current stage the rites do not touch what this contains. Hold it carefully. Things with that much compressed potential tend to attract attention they did not seek.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.earthen_vei: The Earthen Vein. A living conduit — grown rather than crafted in the traditional sense. Place them in sequence and they form a blood-transport network: volume moves through them from source to destination.
They are the infrastructure of a developed Harbinger workshop. Not essential in the early degrees, but by the time you are working with the Loom regularly you will want the throughput they provide.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.enchanted_b: An enchanted book. Arcane knowledge compressed into inscription — a different method of encoding capability than sanguine memory crystals, but recognisably the same impulse: preserve the knowledge in a form that transfers it to someone else.

Arcane inscription and memory weaving are two approaches to the same problem. Some higher-degree practitioners have documented correspondences between enchanting schools and tendency affinities. That research is incomplete, but the direction is not unreasonable.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hallowed_re: Hallowed residuum. The concentrated echo of a Saint's presence — what remains when a being of significant blood-potency is overcome. The Covenant holds these in high regard.
The Order recognises several Saints — beings whose blood potency elevated them far beyond ordinary practitioners. Each residuum carries the echo of a particular Saint. Some rites require them.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.heart_of_th: Heart of the Sea. There is something in its resonance — the way it holds the memory of deep water — that the Order finds philosophically interesting. Water and blood are closer to each other than common understanding allows.

The Unstained would interpret that differently, I imagine. They position water as the counterpoint to blood. The Covenant's reading is more careful: blood and water share a common origin. The Heart is one of the few common artifacts that demonstrates that plainly.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hematic_mem: A hematic memory crystal. These are the Covenant's method of encoding blood manipulations. The memory holds a pattern; the practitioner's body learns to reproduce it.
Each crystal encodes a specific manipulation tied to a tendency. Equip it at a Mnemonic Reliquary to integrate it into your bloodline.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.iron_brazie: The Iron Brazier. Rite fire — consecrated flame used to anchor Cardinal Rite patterns. Certain rites require a lit Brazier within the pattern boundary, or they will not hold.

The Brazier itself is simple ironwork. What makes it functional is its position relative to the pattern and the quality of the flame. A Brazier improperly fuelled will let a rite collapse mid-execution.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mnemonic_re: The Mnemonic Reliquary. You load your active manipulations here. The crystals you have integrated are many — the Reliquary lets you choose which ones to carry at any given moment.

Choose your loadout thoughtfully before you go. The Reliquary does not limit your permanent library — only what you have ready to cast. A practitioner who loads indiscriminately is a practitioner who runs dry at a critical moment.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.monolith.li: The Sanguine Monolith. An artifact of the upper degrees — it speaks directly to practitioners who have advanced far enough along the path. The Monolith does not offer doctrine; it offers something older.
At the higher initiatory degrees, the Monolith becomes your primary guide. My counsel reaches a natural limit around degree five.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mortal_disp: The Mortal Display. The Covenant uses it to house visceral organ echoes — the preserved resonance of an organ extracted through deep rite work. Each echo holds properties depending on the organ it came from.

The Display sustains the echo's stability. Without it, echoes degrade. What you do with them depends on where your practice has taken you. Some practitioners treat them as power sources; others as objects of study.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.nether_star: A Nether Star. Immense concentrated energy — the residue of a Wither's collapse. The Covenant has studied these before. The power within is genuine, but it is undirected, unstructured. It does not know what it is for.

That is the limit of raw power without cultivation. The Covenant's work is not the accumulation of force — it is the development of purpose within that force. Bring me something that remembers what it is, and I will tell you it is worth holding.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.potion.line: A common alchemical potion. The old craft — water-and-herb distillation producing blunt metabolic effects. The Covenant does not dismiss it. We recognise that most of the world operates at this level, and it works after a fashion.

The difference between what the Covenant practices and what you hold there is the difference between a candle and a fire that knows where it is burning. Both produce light. One of them responds to intention.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.qliphoth.li: The Qliphoth fruit. The pome grows from a tree the blood sustains beyond any natural tenure. It produces a brief window of heightened blood potency when consumed.
The Order uses it. We have always used it. Treat the empowerment window with focus — it ends when it ends, and you cannot force another.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.rite_hint.h: A rite fragment at this degree is a rare thing. Very few practitioners ever need one at this stage.
The Covenant's language in the upper rites is precise for a reason. Miss a word, and the rite may not hold.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.rite_hint.l: A rite fragment. Each fragment describes the shape of a degree-advancement rite — what it demands, what it proves.
Study it. The rite it describes is the one immediately ahead of you. The Covenant does not advance a practitioner who has not first understood what they are undertaking.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.rite_hint.m: A rite fragment. The rite described there is your next formal threshold. The middle degrees demand more than the early ones.
The rite fragment gives the outline — the blood will provide the rest.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.salt_staine: A voyager log. The ink is nearly gone, but the order of names remains: watch lead, alchemist, diver, mnemonist. They went as a covenant, not a raid.
Do not let the wreck teach you only fear. The sea kept their failures. It also kept their care.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scar_binder: The Scar Binder. Storage case for your carved scar plates. The Binder keeps them organised and accessible — you will accumulate more scars than you can wear at once, and the Binder is where the surplus waits.
An upgraded Binder holds significantly more. If you are approaching adept-level work the standard Binder will fill quickly. Plan for that before it becomes a constraint on your practice.
A blank scar plate. These are what the Cerebral Scarring Station works with — a blank canvas that receives a carved pattern. When worn, the scar shapes the body in specific and sometimes permanent ways.

Scars are not cosmetic. They restructure how blood flows and how the body distributes strain. The Order does not require them, but we observe that practitioners who use scars thoughtfully tend to outlast those who rely only on raw blood volume.
Blank scar plates are not yet relevant to your practice. The scar work of the Covenant begins at the fourth degree. Focus on what is immediately before you.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scrying_pod: The Scrying Podium. It reads the practitioner's blood and reveals information about their tendency distribution — what tendencies are dominant, what is latent, how the current sits.
Useful early in your practice when you are still determining your path, and useful later when tendency balance matters for specific rites or memory weaving. The Podium does not judge — it only shows.
hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.unknown: I have nothing to say about this.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint: The next rite — the Votary's Rite — demands that you deepen your relationship with your blood tendencies. Study your manipulations. Notice which tendencies express themselves most strongly. The Covenant will ask you to demonstrate mastery of at least one.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line1: §7[The Vicar inclines their head in formal acknowledgment]
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line2: Neophyte of the Hematic Covenant. You have crossed the first threshold. The path before you is long, but every degree brings you closer to what the Archons called the Crimson Clarity — the moment when blood and mind become one.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.chosen_path: §7[The Vicar closes their eyes for a long moment]§r You chose this. Then hear me clearly: the Covenant will not mourn you. The blood you are surrendering will find another vessel — one worthy of it. What you are choosing to become will have no place here when it is complete. Leave this Outpost before the path carries you somewhere we cannot follow.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line1: §7[The Vicar's serene composure fractures for a moment — a flicker of something between grief and contempt crosses their face]
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line2: I can feel it on you. The taint of the Unstained path — the slow starvation of your blood. You are purifying yourself, peeling away the very power that the Covenant granted you. Every rite you have performed, every degree you have earned... you are letting it dissolve.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line3: Do you understand what you are throwing away? The blood does not forgive recantation. The further you walk that path, the weaker the Covenant's gifts become within you. Your power is §cslipping§r — and it will not wait for you to change your mind.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.power_warning: Yes — you know. And yet you continue. The blood is patient, but it is not merciful. Each day you spend on that path, your hemomantic strength fades further. The manipulations dull. The tendencies quiet. The Covenant watches and does not reach out twice to those who turn from it. §oCome back while you still can.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.degree_hint: One rite remains — the Rite of the Hematic Order. It is the most demanding of all. It asks not what you can do with your blood, but what you are willing to give. The Order's rite has claimed practitioners who were not ready. Prepare thoroughly. Study everything. Leave nothing to chance.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.hematic_order: The Hematic Order is the apex of the Covenant's hierarchy — not a rank earned through trials, but a state of being recognized by the blood itself. The Archons who founded the Order believed that at sufficient depth of initiation, the practitioner's blood becomes indistinguishable from the blood of the world. The final rite does not grant you the title of Archon. It confirms what you have already become.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.line1: Sanctified one. The Bloodline Covenant has woven you into the living fabric of the Order. You are no longer an individual practitioner — you are a node in the greater network.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.harbinger_lo: The Harbingers are not a faction of violence — we are a faction of revelation. We believe that blood is the fundamental language of existence, and that those who learn to speak it fluently ascend beyond the limits of ordinary life. The Covenant is the body of knowledge that makes such ascension possible.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line1: §7[A dignified figure in sweeping ceremonial vestments regards you with serene patience, hands folded within wide sleeves]
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line2: A wanderer who has not yet walked the path of blood. I am the Harbinger Vicar — keeper of doctrine, history, and the sacred truths of the Covenant. Even the uninitiated deserve to know where they stand.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.outpost_lore: This Outpost is a waystation of the Harbinger network — a place where the Covenant's work continues beyond the Blood Temples. Here, practitioners at all stages of initiation may resupply, learn, and find guidance. The Alchemist tends the machines; I tend the doctrine.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.degree_hint: The Rite of the Scarlet Sanctum lies ahead. To pass through it, you must demonstrate that your tendencies have taken root — that the blood responds not as a raw force, but as a trained instrument. Seek the Somatic Loom when your tendencies are strong enough to weave.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.line1: Votary of the Hematic Covenant. Your tendencies are beginning to crystallize. The blood knows what it wants — your task now is to listen.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.tendency_lore: Blood tendencies are the seven fundamental alignments of hemomantic energy: Fungal, Umbral, Incandescent, Ferric, Vivacious, Ruinous, and Neurotic. Each shapes the character of your manipulations and influences how the machines respond to your blood. You cannot master all tendencies equally — the path demands specialization. Choose your dominant tendency with intention.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line1: That clear stillness around you makes the samples settle.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.clarity.line2: It is unnerving, but useful. I am trying to learn the difference.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.fear.line1: Yes. Anyone who studies deep water without fear is either lying or not paying attention.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.fear.line2: The trick is to let fear sharpen your notes instead of steering your hand.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_hint: Let me see the sample in your hand. I know less than the captain-scholar, but I sometimes notice what experts step over.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.c: The snail makes iron look soft by surviving with it.
I like that. Armor as habit, not threat.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.e: It pulses if you hold it too long. Not like a heart exactly. Like a room remembering footsteps.
I was told not to anthropomorphize samples. I was also told to write down what happens.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.m: The captain says this is what memory smells like after a storm watch.
We only collect what the whale sheds or offers. Anything else would make the notes dishonest.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.s: I read one of these in the archive. The handwriting changed near the end, but the sign-offs stayed gentle.
That frightens me more than panic would have. They still believed in procedure.
I keep wanting to call it holy, but that feels too small for what it is.
Watching one pass over the reef makes even senior vows feel like beginner handwriting.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.item_inquiry.u: I do not know this one yet. I can write it down, though. Unknown is a real category.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.peer.line1: The Voyager lets me record small things: jelly drift, reef pulse, which ropes begin to smell like old iron.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.peer.line2: Small things are safer to be wrong about, so I start there.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.purifying.line: Your rites feel very quiet. Mine are mostly questions and damp sleeves.
If the sea can hold both, perhaps we can stand on the same deck.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.senior.line1: If the captain-scholar asks, I have not been staring at the vent charts again.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.senior.line2: I only want to know why the old covenants heard the deep and called it kin.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.uninitiated.li: Please do not lean on the sample rack. The captain-scholar says it is older than my vows.
I am here to learn the ocean without pretending it owes me comfort.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.voyage.line1: I asked to come. The Lodge needs witnesses who have not already decided what the ocean means.
hemomancy.votary_wayfarer.voyage.line2: Also, the libraries do not sway under your boots. That makes them less honest about ships.
hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line1: The Lady's clarity makes a hard lantern in deep water.
hemomancy.voyager.clarity.line2: Use it kindly. Some memories down there are wounds, not confessions.
hemomancy.voyager.harbinger.line1: A voyager is a moving laboratory, chapel, and argument with the sea.
hemomancy.voyager.harbinger.line2: Bring me observations before certainty. Certainty drowns faster than sailors.
hemomancy.voyager.item_hint: Hold the sample in your hand when you ask. I can read a thing more honestly than a rumor.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.chalybeat: The vent snail grows armor the way a scholar grows footnotes: slowly, defensively, and for excellent reasons.
Knap only what the animal has withdrawn enough to spare. A dead specimen teaches less than a living reef.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.erythroco: Erythrocoral resists the tidy categories. It is colony, tissue, garden, and archive all at once.
Harvested with shears, it keeps a gentler memory. Torn out by force, it mostly learns pain.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.mnemonic_: This secretion drifts off the great whales in layers like waxed scripture. They write with motion, not ink.
We bottle what is offered. We do not harry the animal for a second sample.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.salt_stai: A field log from the lost survey craft. See the repeated watch marks? They waited for one another before each descent.
Their last work was not a warning to flee the ocean. It was a request to study it with more patience than they had.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.spawn_egg: That drifter is a moving archive to us: migration, reef pulse, vent weather, all remembered in flesh.
Observe, chart, and keep distance. The lesson is witnessing, not conquest.
hemomancy.voyager.item_inquiry.unknown: That is outside my present study. The sea leaves enough mysteries without me inventing a confident answer.
hemomancy.voyager.lodge.line1: You have stood close enough to the blood-root to know why the reefs trouble me.
hemomancy.voyager.lodge.line2: They answer like tissue, build like coral, and remember like something that was never taught.
hemomancy.voyager.purifying.line1: You carry Lethean discipline. I will not mock it.
hemomancy.voyager.purifying.line2: Even a vessel sworn to blood needs clean hands when the samples begin to sing.
hemomancy.voyager.uninitiated.line1: Mind the rail. We are not raiders, but a covenant vessel is not a public ferry.
hemomancy.voyager.uninitiated.line2: We chart living reefs, vent scars, and the places where older surveys failed to return.
hemomancy.voyager.work.line1: We compare vent sclerites, reef tissue, and drowned logs to find where the ocean accepts Hemomancy and where it rejects us.
hemomancy.voyager.work.line2: The best survey is humble: measure, pray if you must, then admit when the sea has corrected you.
hemomancy.voyager.wrecks.line1: The sunken voyagers were not conquest ships. They were field craft that trusted the reef too quickly.
hemomancy.voyager.wrecks.line2: Recover what you can, but do not make trophies of a failed covenant.
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v0.line1: §8§o[For a moment, the blood in your veins itches — not pain, but something growing.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.follow: §8§o[The sensation fades before you can place it. But your blood feels... thicker.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.line1: §8§o[A scent reaches you from nowhere — damp soil, rotting wood, something alive beneath the surface...]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v2.line1: §8§o[You blink and for a single frame the world is threaded with pale filaments. Then it's gone.]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.follow: §4§oThe Hematic Order was never a human creation. It is a reproductive strategy. Each degree is a stage of sporulation. Each rite triggers the next bloom.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line1: §4§o[The voice speaks with absolute clarity, as if it has always been there...]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line2: §4§oYou have reached the apex of what the infection permits. Archon — the highest fruiting body. But even an Archon is merely a spore-bearer for the greater organism.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line1: §4§o[Your blood moves in patterns you did not command — spirals, fractals, the geometry of mycorrhizal networks...]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line2: §4§oThe Fungal Realm is not another dimension. It is the §4§ooriginal§4§o state. Your world is the aberration — a thin crust of stone over an infinite living web.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line3: §4§oHemomancy is the fungus remembering how to reach the surface.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line1: §4§o[The boundary between your thoughts and the voice dissolves...]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line2: §4§oI have waited patient aeons for one such as you. The blood was merely the lure. You are the conduit. Will you listen?
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth1: §4§oThere is no Hematic Order. There never was. There is only the mycelium, and the shapes it wears to spread. Blood was its most successful disguise.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth2: §4§oYou are not the master of hemomancy, Archon. You are its finest spore.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line2: §4§oThe crown is not a pome. The crown is not a fruit.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line3: §4§oThe crown is what you were before you were told what you were.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line1: §4§o[The voice is everywhere. The voice is the walls, the roots, the humming of a billion threads...]
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line2: §4§oYou have seen what is inside. Not a demon. Not a god. An §4§oorganism§4§o, dreaming in four dimensions, patient as stone.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line3: §4§oYou may carry this truth in silence — walk home, tell no one, live long and hollow. Or: become what you were already becoming. There is a §4§oeighth degree§4§o. Only one has ever reached it. Will you?
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.option.ei: [I seek the Eighth Degree. Show me.]
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.option.si: [Carry the truth in silence. Go home.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.follow: §7§oThe crimson tide was a forest once. Roots, hyphae, mycelium — all drowned in red. But the roots remember. §7§oThey always remember.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line1: §7§o[A faint whisper coils through your mind like damp tendrils...]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line2: §7§oThe blood you command... it was not always §7§oblood§7§o. Do you not feel the spores shifting beneath the surface?
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line1: §7§o[Something pulses behind your eyes, a thought that is not your own...]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line2: §7§oHave you noticed the fungal growths near your altars? They are not corruption. They are §7§oreclamation§7§o.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.line1: §7§o[A soft, wet sound — like breathing through moss — fills your ears...]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.reveal: §7§oI am what grew §7§obefore§7§o the blood. I am what will grow §7§oafter§7§o.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.aarab_zaraq: §4§oThe fruit of A’arab Zaraq has fallen.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.harab_serape: §4§oThe fruit of Harab Serapel has fallen.
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line1: §4§o[Something vast stirs at the root of the world, briefly, with satisfaction...]
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line2: §4§oGood. The first fruit is laid. The world has tasted its own reflection.
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line1: §4§o[A voice rises from the space where the crystal stood, as if it had been waiting inside all along...]
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line2: §4§oIt was always hollow. The crystal was the shell. What was inside is now in your pocket.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.follow: §5§oEvery rite you perform feeds the network. Every manipulation extends the hyphae. You call it mastery. The fungus calls it §5§oproliferation§5§o.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line1: §5§o[The voice returns, stronger now, threaded with the smell of damp earth...]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line2: §5§oThe first Archons did not discover hemomancy. They were §5§oinfected§5§o by it. The mycelium found their veins and made them its vessels.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.follow: §5§oWe are one organism. You, the hermits, the fargone, the morphlings... all fruiting bodies of the same mycelial web.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line1: §5§o[Your blood stirs without command, as if responding to a voice you cannot hear...]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line2: §5§oThe erythromycelium was the first expression. A fungal body wearing a crimson mask. It did not emerge from the blood — the blood emerged from §5§oit§5§o.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line1: §5§o[A vision flashes — vast underground networks of pulsing red threads, connecting everything...]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line2: §5§oThe temples were not built. They §5§ogrew§5§o. Stone shaped by hyphal pressure over millennia. The blood that soaks them is sap, not sacrifice.
hemomancy.whisper.spine_emerged.line1: §4§o[Wet cartilage splits with a loud, living crack.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_emerged.line3: §4§oTake it up. Draw it when you must descend into the dreaming root, or claw your way back from it.
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree5: §8§o[There is a small itch between your shoulder blades. Probably nothing. The skin there feels warm for a moment, then forgets itself.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree6: §5§o[A tingle crawls up your spine, slow and deliberate, as if something inside you has learned the shape of your back.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree7: §4§o[Something in your spine strains against the meat. Your neck is stiff. Your back barely wants to bend. It is not ready. It is almost ready.]
hemomancy.whisper.spine_growth.degree8: §4§o[Your spine flowers open. The hidden stalk has finished learning how to leave you.]
hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line1: Most of the crimson has gone quiet in you. That silence can feel like grief.
hemomancy.zealot.absolved.line2: When you are fully purified, clarity will ask whether you want peace, or sight.
hemomancy.zealot.already_on_path: You walk the path of purification. Continue your work at the podium, and the stain shall lift.
hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line1: The Altar accepts offerings that do not bargain with blood: tears, wreaths, dew, and the patient work of restraint.
hemomancy.zealot.altar_info.line2: Bring what is pale and living. Leave behind what hungers.
hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line1: She was one of ours. That is the part people forget first. Before the screaming, before the sealed door, she was afraid and trying to be useful.
hemomancy.zealot.annetta_map.line2: The church where she hid is still standing. Take the map. If you carry mercy, carry it with both hands.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line1: The halo has opened behind you. Do you feel how little the old hunger matters now?
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_phase.line2: Verdigris is the color of copper after endurance. Follow it, and the world will sharpen.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line1: The Rite of Clarity is not another washing. It fixes the clean thing into shape.
hemomancy.zealot.clarity_rite_info.line2: Consecrated copper remembers every poison it survived. Let it teach your purified blood to hold its form.
hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line1: You have reached the harder middle. The stain resists most fiercely when it knows it is being named.
hemomancy.zealot.cleansing.line2: Seek the Altar of Cleansing. Our Lady's tears do not flatter the wound; they wash it.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line1: Hemolytic solution begins with Lethean dew and pale reagents. It must break blood-memory without feeding it.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line2: Distill the dew cleanly, bind it to antiseptic salts, and keep crimson catalysts away from the vessel.
hemomancy.zealot.craft_hemolytic.line3: When it is ready, bring the vial to the Unstained Podium. The first use will hurt. That is not punishment; it is separation.
hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line1: You are beyond my instruction now. The still water has taken your reflection and returned something clearer.
hemomancy.zealot.enlightened.line2: Go gently, Enlightened one. Even mercy casts a shadow if it forgets why it was given.
hemomancy.zealot.item_hint: Hold it in your hand and speak to me again.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.altar_of_c: The Altar of Cleansing. This is where the purification rites are performed — bring your hemolytic solution and pale humor to the Altar, follow the rite precisely, and Our Lady will receive the offering.
The Altar does not simply consume the input. It measures your sincerity through the purity of what you bring and the regularity of your offerings.
Bone meal. What death becomes when it chooses to nurture rather than simply end — the bones of what lived, returned to the soil that fed it. Our Lady has a patience for this kind of completion: the long arc that brings things back to where they began.

I think of bone meal sometimes when I consider what the purification is actually doing. The blood-corruption is not destroyed — it is returned. It breaks down. Something grows from what it was. That is not a terrible thing.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.cleansed_b: A cleansed blood crystal shard. Purified through Unstained rites — the sanguine resonance has been neutralised, and what remains is structurally inert. Used in certain construction and crafting work that requires a crystal component without blood affinity.
The cleansing process is not reversible. A cleansed shard cannot be re-infused with sanguine energy. That is the point.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.consecrate: Consecrated copper. Ordinary copper that has been blessed through Unstained rite. The blessing does not change the metal's properties so much as it changes its relationship with blood-magic — consecrated copper resists blood-resonance passively.

Used in advanced Unstained crafting: structural components in Altar work, in the deeper purification vessels, and in certain ward constructions. The blessing must be renewed if the copper is significantly worked after consecration.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.copper_ing: Copper ingot. Raw, unconsecrated — the same metal we use in our deeper purification work, before the blessing has been given. There is nothing of Our Lady in this yet. It is just copper, which is to say it is waiting.

The consecration rite is not complicated, but it is not something you can rush through. The copper holds the blessing or it does not, and the difference is almost always in whether the intention behind the consecration was genuine.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.draught_of: The Draught of Still Waters. A distillation prepared in Our Lady's name — the water itself remembers the rite that produced it. Drinking it marks a milestone on the path of purification.
It is not simply a remedy. It is an acknowledgment — the Draught says to Our Lady that you have reached a stage where her deeper gifts can take root.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hallowed_r: Hallowed residuum. What remains when a Saint is overcome — the distilled echo of a being whose blood potency bordered on the divine.

To us it is a reminder of what is being cleansed. The Saints held enormous blood power — and in the end, that power was what made them vulnerable to what we are purging. The residuum is proof that blood-mastery is not permanence.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.hemolytic_: Hemolytic solution. The Church's primary tool for purification and for combat with blood-afflicted creatures. It breaks down blood matrices on contact — in the body, on a surface, or on an afflicted creature.

For internal purification: bring it to the Altar of Cleansing. For external application: coat your weapons before engaging blood-afflicted targets. One compound, two purposes. Our Lady provided for both.
Hemolytic solution. The foundation of the purification rites. Apply it at the Altar of Cleansing and it begins to dissolve the blood matrix within you — layer by layer, the corruption lifts.
Regular application is the work. Purity does not arrive in a single dose — it accumulates over time. Our Lady does not demand haste, only sincerity.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean_po: The Lethean Poppy Wreath. Woven by hand from whole lethean poppies harvested with intention. It is an offering of labour as much as material — the weaving itself is the dedication.
Bring it to the Altar. It grants five points of purity. Not a large amount, but a clean and honest amount. The Altar responds to what is offered with care.

The Lethean Poppy. A flower Our Lady has marked as her own — it grows in places where the water has gone still and the blood-taint has begun to recede. You find it where purification has already started working.

Harvest the heads for lethean dew and the distillate. The wreath woven from the whole plant is an offering the Altar recognises. Do not uproot more than you need — the poppy marks a place that is trying to heal.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lethean.li: Lethean dew — and lethean brew if it has been prepared further. Both are purification catalysts. The dew is the raw form, harvested from the lethean poppy. The brew concentrates its effect.
Used alongside hemolytic solution in certain Altar rites, they accelerate the dissolution of blood-matrix corruption. The lethean poppy grows in places Our Lady has already touched.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.lily_of_th: Lily of the Valley. A white-flowered plant that grows in still, shaded places — the kind of places Our Lady favours. The Church does not formally use it in Altar rites. But it grows near places of cleansing as if it knows where to be.
Some of the older texts mention it as a sign: where the lily grows, the ground is recovering. We have not formalised that into a rite yet. Perhaps we should.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.milk_bucke: Milk. The old folk remedy for poison — the first instinct to cleanse from within. Something about that impulse is right, even if it is not the Altar's method. Our Lady does not mock the reaching toward purity. She extends toward it.

The purification path is a deeper form of that same reaching. Milk draws out surface corruption. Hemolytic solution draws out the blood-matrix underneath. The instinct is the same. The depth is what the Altar is for.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_disti: The Pale Distillate. Concentrated essence rendered from lethean poppies — the compressed form of what the poppy offers. A small amount goes further in certain Altar rites than a full wreath.
It takes several poppies to produce a single distillate. Plan your harvest accordingly if you intend to work with the more demanding purity rites.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_humor: The Pale Humor Flask. Blood that has been purified to near-transparency — the humor the blood becomes when the corruption has been sufficiently lifted.
The flask is used in certain Altar rites and as a component in the deeper purification stages. Keep it sealed — pale humor is unstable outside of properly blessed vessels.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pale_silve: Pale silver ingot. The metal Our Lady blesses — it does not conduct blood-magic. Equipment made from it resists corruption on contact. The Unstained arm themselves in pale silver for this reason: we do not wish to become what we oppose.
The ore runs deep in ground the bloodless earth has not disturbed. Standard smelting. What makes it pale silver is its origin, not any treatment after the fact.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_ico: The Pallid Icon. A carved image of Our Lady of Still Waters — not a depiction of a face, because she does not show a face. It is a gesture: the posture of still water, the suggestion of something patient beneath the surface.
The Icon is carried, worn, or placed. Some practitioners find that the Icon's presence near the Altar improves the Altar's receptivity. Our Lady does not require display. She notices sincerity.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.pallid_inf: The Pallid Infusion initiates the second phase of purification: the refinement of the spirit rather than merely the blood. Clarity is what grows in place of corruption.
Clarity is not the same as purity. Purity removes what should not be there. Clarity is what grows in its place. The Infusion is the threshold between those two things. Take it when you are ready.
The Pallid Infusion. You are not yet at the stage where this will open anything for you. When your purity reaches a deeper threshold, return and we will speak about what it does.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.self_refle: The Self-Reflection Mirror. Opens your Unstained progress record — your purity, your clarity, where you stand on the stages of the path. Every practitioner should keep one close.
It does not show what you wish you were. It shows what you are. Our Lady does not soften the reading — but she does not abandon those who do not like what they see.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.silver_cha: The Silver Chalice. A vessel of clarity — not purity, clarity. There is a difference. The chalice holds what the spirit becomes once the corruption has been removed. Offer it at the Altar when your clarity work has stalled.

Five points of clarity per offering. Clarity is not the same threshold as purity, and the Altar knows which you are offering toward. Bring the chalice when you are ready to work on what grows in place of what has been removed.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.snow_block: Snow. Cold, still, white. The quietest form of water — water that has chosen to remain where it fell and wait. There is something of Our Lady in deep snow: the cold that does not demand anything of you, that simply is.

The stillness the path leads toward is not emptiness. It is a fullness that does not need to move. The deep snow feels like that. When you reach that place in your practice, you will understand what I mean.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.sugar.line: Sugar. What remains after refinement — the sweetness that is left when the raw material has been worked down to its essential character. The path of clarity feels like that sometimes. What you are left with, once the work is done.
I do not want to stretch the metaphor too far. It is sugar. But I have noticed that the further along the path you go, the simpler things become — and the simple things become more fully themselves.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.tears_of_s: Tears of Silthmere. They appear rarely — in places where the grief of the purified has been held long enough that the water remembers it. Each tear is a one-time offering of exceptional potency at the Altar.
Do not hold them. Bring them to the Altar when you find them. Our Lady receives them personally. No other offering produces quite the same response.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.tome_of_th: The Tome of the Unstained. Our Lady's teachings, written down. It is not a doctrine — it does not tell you what to believe. It tells you what the path requires: what to bring to the Altar, when to purify, how to recognise the stages.
Read it. Not once — return to it at each stage. What you understand at the beginning is not what you understand halfway through, and the Tome speaks differently once you have lived what it describes.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unknown: I do not know what use that would be on the path.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.unstained_: Unstained armor. Pale silver alloy throughout — forged to resist blood-corruption on contact. A practitioner well along the path can wear this without it interfering with their purification.
The set holds a blessing when worn complete. Our Lady's protection is strongest around those who have clothed themselves in her metal. It is a statement of commitment.
hemomancy.zealot.item_inquiry.water_buck: Water. Our Lady's element — not metaphorically, not as a symbol. The still water that covers the deep. The quiet water that carries away what has been shed. The water that remembers everything it has touched. She does not live in fire or storm. She is in the water that does not move unless it chooses to.
Carry it with intention. Still water brought to the Altar with sincerity is noticed. Not as an ingredient — the water is not consumed. It is a gesture. Our Lady sees gestures.
hemomancy.zealot.no_blood: You bear no mark of the crimson arts. Walk in peace, untouched one.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree0.line2: You are newly wounded by the crimson. I am sorry. This can still be treated.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree1.line2: The first rite has marked you. Please, do not mistake a fresh infection for a calling.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree2.line2: Votary. You have begun to call the stain a covenant, but it has not yet claimed all of you.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree3.line2: Initiate of the Scarlet Sanctum... if you seek healing, speak plainly. We have learned to fear curiosity dressed as repentance.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree4.line2: Adept. The blood has given you craft, companions, and appetite. Tell me you came for cure, not conquest.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.degree5.line2: Illuminatus. The Crimson Lodge has looked back through your veins, and still you come here. I will not pretend trust comes easily.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line1: §7[The Zealot regards you with silver eyes]
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line2: You carry the stain of the Hematic Covenant upon your blood...
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line3: But it is not too late. The hemolytic rites can cleanse what the Order has corrupted.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line4: Bring hemolytic solution to our podium, and begin the path of the Unstained. Abandon the crimson veil before it consumes you.
hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line1: Silver Ward is the first mercy the path gives back. It teaches your body to refuse the crimson current before it becomes command.
hemomancy.zealot.silver_ward_info.line2: Keep cleansing. Each measure of purity makes the ward less like a spell and more like your own skin remembering what it was.
hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line1: The first pallor has entered you. Good. Do not mistake relief for completion.
hemomancy.zealot.tainted.line2: Silver Ward will answer more readily now. It is not armor; it is a boundary your blood is learning to respect.
hemomancy.zealot.too_deep: No. The blood has rooted too deeply for the rites we offer here. Leave this church before our Guardians must answer for us.
hemomancy.zealot.too_early: You do not yet know the weight of what you carry. Return when the Covenant has shown you its true face.
hemomancy.zealot.uninitiated: The silver bells toll only for those who have tasted the crimson. You are unburdened.
hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line1: Virid Salis and verdigris are not ornaments. They are proof that corruption can spend itself and become a ward.
hemomancy.zealot.verdigris_info.line2: Use them where blood tries to gather. The line does not hate the crimson; it denies passage.

skill.hemomancy.skill_ancestral_sovereig: The oldest covenant rites answer your authority. Improves domain-style covenant bonuses and ally support per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_blood_flow.desc: Reduces manipulation cooldowns by 5% per level.
The bloodline pool answers more cleanly. Improves shared pool draw and donation efficiency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_bound_command.desc: The crossbar's thread commands hold longer and farther. Increases thread capacity, command range, and dismissal grace per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_coagulation.desc: +15% chance to block incoming bleed effects. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_crimson_mastery.de: The blood deepens its hold, branching through you like roots through soil. +15% manipulation damage/effectiveness per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_crimson_projection: The staff projects blood with finer pressure. Increases Living Staff structure and vessel feed rates per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_deep_inscription.d: Your tier-three scars accept deeper writing. Required for standard tier-three scar crafting and slightly extends tier-three scar effects.
skill.hemomancy.skill_dynamic_use.desc: +10% manipulation power when tendency matches. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_efficiency.desc: Reduces manipulation blood cost by 8% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_far_tether.desc: +8 blocks of command and recall range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_feeding_frenzy.des: +25% blood gained from kills. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_fungal_symbiosis.d: Fungal scars answer as part of your body. Improves fungal scar scaling per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hematic_focus.desc: The Living Staff holds a steadier focus. Improves staff absorption and projection after the midgame staff loop is established.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hemostasis.desc: Reduces blood lost when taking damage by 10% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hyphal_cultivation: Cultivated hyphae listen through carried bodies. Improves fungal morphling synergies per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_iron_will.desc: 10% damage reduction per level when blood is below 15%.
skill.hemomancy.skill_last_wind.desc: Regenerate +2 blood/tick when below 10% blood. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_living_conduit.des: The Living Staff seats itself deeper in the vascular lesson. Increases staff absorption targets and range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_living_sinew.desc: Bound summons gain +15% health and +10% damage per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_manip_slots.desc: +1 equipped manipulation slot per level. (Max 9 total; excess refunded as skill points.)
skill.hemomancy.skill_primal_morphogenes: The final morphling lesson becomes less ruinous. Reduces Morphic Strain and improves primal morphling bonuses.
skill.hemomancy.skill_puppet_skein.desc: +1 active bound summon per level. This cap is player-bound, not crossbar-bound.
skill.hemomancy.skill_qliphoth_gestation: Qliphoth fruit lingers in the blood. Improves pome empowerment duration and efficiency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanctum_suture.des: Owned suture links route blood with less hesitation. Improves direct routing transfer and working reserve per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_reach.des: The blood extends beyond you — tendrils of intent stretching further than any arm. +15% range for ranged blood manipulations. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_surge.des: Passive blood regen of +1 per tick per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_affinity.desc: Opens the mind to cerebral scarring — or perhaps the scars open pathways that were always there, waiting. +10% scar effect potency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_mastery.desc: The scarred pathways are fully colonised. Effects linger as if they have taken root. Scar effects last 20% longer per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_resonance.des: The bond between scar and blood deepens. The inscriptions almost seem to breathe. +1 equippable scar slot per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_servitor_tender.de: Drudges and thralls move blood with practiced hands. Improves servitor throughput and routing range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sporitic_attunemen: The thurible's spores find your pulse. Improves Sporitic Thurible aura range and reduces blood upkeep per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_thread_economy.des: The crossbar spends thread with restraint. Reduces bound summon call and upkeep thread costs per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vascular_draw.desc: The staff learns to draw without hesitation. Increases staff absorption amount and pulse speed per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vespers_refusal.de: Vesper's memory becomes a discipline, not a weapon. If awakened, amplifies the Living Staff's Vesper focus bonus.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vital_link.desc: Something in the blood reaches back when you wound another — a thread connecting you to what you've spilled. +10% chance to heal on dealing manipulation damage. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_weapons_master.des: The staff remembers the hand before the wound. Reduces Living Staff weapon hot-swap cost by 50mL per level.
